無所畏懼
programme.desc: 由熱依扎王陽啜妮沈羽潔主演故事講述羅英子熱依扎飾原本是機關工作人員，自學法律通過了司法考試，卻遭遇打擊：丈夫劉銘與她感情破裂，劉銘更在國內欠下巨額高利貸，讓羅英子深陷債務危機但羅英子並沒有放棄，她選擇用法律手段還擊羅英子作為律所新人，一方面背負著巨額債款，一方面又要面對職場上壓力，幸而她遇到了志同道合的夥伴-邱華啜妮飾夏舒沈羽潔飾她們始終堅持對法律的信仰，堅持伸張正義，通過一宗宗案件見證了人性百態和社會冷暖羅英子等人成長為金牌律師，詐騙危機也被化解

坐月攻略
programme.desc: 由孫慧雪主持，全方位講解女人坐月的重要性和陪月員的角色及資訊透過專業陪月的見解和經驗分享，幫助觀眾了解坐月對身心健康的影響，坐月禁忌及必學坐月餐單，提高觀眾對於坐月的認識和重要性，並傳遞正確的飲食建議

programme.desc: 我們的河山改編自同名小説由劉戈建編劇，毛衛寧執導，王雷陳鈺琪焦俊豔張天陽領銜主演的一套以抗戰為題材的電視劇1937年，抗日烽火燃遍華夏在崮城縣，滿懷熱血的青年共產黨員莊埼風（王雷飾），在其上級領導周密的指導下，深入民間，展開了一場艱鉅的敵後鬥爭他們遵循論持久戰的戰略方針，透過減租減息組織農救會等方式，成功喚醒並團結了廣大群眾，將渙散的力量凝聚成抗日的洪流莊埼風不僅帶領民眾剷除魚肉鄉民的土匪，更組織武裝力量對日偽政權發起有力打擊在八路軍一一五師的支援下，軍民同心，生死相依，逐步建立起穩固的抗日根據地他們在敵人的高壓統治下，憑藉無比的勇氣與智慧，硬是撕開了一道封鎖的裂口，將孤勇化為合力最終，他們成功反擊了日軍的多次掃蕩，徹底擊潰了淪陷區的偽政權，迎來了抗戰的偉大勝利

乘風踏浪
programme.desc: 乘風踏浪由喬杉楊子姍領銜主演的時代創業喜劇該劇講述了以彭錦西和羅虹夫婦為代表的興城泳裝人乘著改革東風成功創業的故事，通過兩個小人物從解決溫飽到成為萬元戶，再到成為當地企業家代表的歷程，將時代發展浪潮的關鍵節點一一還原，以小見大地展現出改革開放的變遷史ampampampltbrampampampgt1978年，20歲的遼寧興城人彭錦西（喬杉飾）被情敵秦升舉報投機倒把入獄，失去了上大學的資格彭錦西出獄後自產自銷做起泳褲生意，女友羅虹（楊子姍飾）不離不棄，他們克服重重困難喜結連理，彭錦西成為當地第一個萬元戶1980年代初，政策放開，遠親賈為民等人效仿彭錦西建作坊做泳裝，開始與他展開價格戰，彭錦西夫婦見招拆招，既鞏固了本地市場，又團結了同行，讓興城泳裝走向全國1990年代，彭錦西遭遇秦升復仇和市場整改的雙面夾擊，跌入低谷，他依舊樂觀，憑藉過人的智慧，幾經沉浮找到突破口，建立正規工廠和自主品牌，成功突圍之後，夫婦二帶領興城泳裝乘風踏浪，成為全球最大的泳裝生產基地

programme.title: 一個人鐵道行 3
programme.desc: 一個人鐵道行 3 是一個充滿冒險精神的旅遊節目，引領觀眾搭乘鐵道探索中國各地的城市文化美景美食和人文每天用兩刻鐘，展示中國鐵路網的便捷和各地奇趣第三季我們從廣州出發，搭乘 Z264 列車，一路向西北開往西藏拉薩，耗時 54 小時，穿越中原大地和西部地區，最後抵達世界屋脊青藏高原，這是一趟橫跨東西兩端近五千公里的冒險！ 香港新生代主持阮偉倫，用一張火車票，走遍鄭州少林寺千年古都洛陽中國境內最大高原湖泊青海湖再從文化交會的西寧開始一路爬升青藏鐵路，抵達西藏，世界屋脊上的神秘淨土！

programme.desc: 中國湖北省石首市天鵝洲濕地，國家麋鹿自然保護區的工作人員們焦急不已，從小被人類收養的麋鹿孤兒團圓已然到了談婚論嫁的年齡，但傲嬌的麋鹿公主一直與人類生活在一起，對人類無比依戀的她卻對自己的族群一無所知過去的四年裡，工作人員們一直在研究和嘗試各種方案讓團圓重返野生麋鹿族群，然而這條回歸之路卻並不順利年富力強的鹿王一條一刻不敢鬆懈，以黑娃為首的年輕公鹿們窺視皇位已久，王權爭奪一觸即發，為了維繫自己族群的繁衍，它必須不斷擊退挑戰者ampampampltbrampampampgt攝製組歷時三年，先後深入湖北湖南北京江蘇等地，並且結合遠距離遙控四季延時貼近航拍等技術手段，第一次系統生動的呈現了麋鹿：這一古老生物的隱秘生活本節目由ampampamplt湖北廣播電視台ampampampgt贈播

programme.title: 아기공룡 둘리
programme.desc: 아기공룡 둘리quot를 1983년부터 10년간 보물섬에서 연재하던 원작자 김수정씨는 국산 만화 캐릭터를 지속적이고, 세계적인 캐릭터로 성장 시키기 위해서는 조직적인 활동의 필요함을 느끼고 1995년 2월에 주둘리나라를 설립했다.1996년 7월 장편 만화영화 quot아기공룡 둘리quot를 제작하여 COEX 외 전국 극장에서 상영했으며 현재 미라클에서 비디오 테이프제작 판매중이다.1999년 1월 17일 베를린을 시작으로 독일극장에 상영했었고, 독일 영화개봉에 맞춰 음반 및 비디오, 게임도 같이 판매하는 큰 성과를 올렸다.

programme.title: 요괴워치
programme.desc: 아주 평범한 동네, 진달래 마을에 사는 엄청 평범한 초등학교 5학년 민호는 어느 여름 날 기묘하고 하얀 생물인 위스퍼와 만나게 된다. 민호를 따라다니던 위스퍼는 신기한 시계 요괴워치를 민호에게 건네고.. 그날부터 마을 곳곳에 나타나는 요괴들이 보이기 시작한다! 일상 생활에서 벌어지는 곤란한 사건의 모든 것은 요괴가 원인이다?! 민호는 사건을 일으키는 요괴들을 설득하고 때때로는 싸우며 사건을 해결한다. 그리고 요괴들과 친구가 된다! 오늘은 또 어떤 새로운 요괴를 만나게 될까?

programme.title: 파파독
programme.desc: 늘 사랑스럽고 씩씩한 골목대장 별이. 하지만 그런 별이도 가끔은 쓸쓸한 모습을 보일 때가 있다. 그 이유는 별이의 가장 친한 친구이자 든든한 보호자가 되어 주었던 아빠가 해외 출장을 갔기 때문인데... 오늘도 홀로 가방을 챙기고 학교로 향하는 별이, 그런데 왠 개 한마리가 앞을 가로 막는다. 별이를 보며 반갑다는 듯 꼬리를 흔들던 개! 갑자기 두발로 일어나더니 사람처럼 말을 하기 시작하는데... 별아, 내가 니 아빠다, Im your farther! 어이없는 상황에 눈이 휘둥그래진 별이, 그리고 감정이 북받치는 듯 눈물을 흘리는 개! 과연 어떻게 된 일일까?? 배꼽 잡는 소동과 따뜻한 가족의 사랑이 담긴, 아빠가 개가 됐어요!, 개 변신 애니시트콤 파파독의 이야기가 시작된다.

programme.title: 楚喬傳
programme.desc: 南北朝西魏年間亂世混戰，大批平民在戰亂中淪為奴隸，命如草芥奴籍少女楚喬被送入人獵場供貴族娛樂射殺，幸得燕北世子燕洵與宇文玥暗中相救，隨後她被帶進權傾朝野的門閥宇文家目睹兄姐相繼慘死，立誓要帶妹妹逃出牢籠楚喬受到開明貴族宇文玥關注，被迫接受嚴厲訓練的同時，更與燕洵結下深厚友誼西魏門閥爭鬥，燕洵一家滿門被滅，深陷絕境，楚喬與他生死相守併力助他逃脫困局然而回到燕北後，燕洵野心膨脹，不惜以滿城百姓性命為代價割據稱雄楚喬在絕望中與燕洵分道揚鑣，並與力求天下一統釋奴止戈的宇文玥並肩作戰，粉碎了燕洵的復仇計劃，成為心懷蒼生的巾幗將軍權臣宇文泰也在良臣勸諫下釋放奴隸，荼毒數百年掠民為奴的暴政至此終結

programme.desc: 雄主登巔野心不減 帝國極盛暗藏風雲步入中年的漢武帝，稱帝二十餘年，驅伊稚部落於漠北，削諸藩而一統，富國強兵，使大漢王朝進入了輝煌鼎盛時期 永不滿足的漢武帝，不斷設計自己的人生藍圖他聯合西域，穩定北疆，再無後顧之憂；又將目光轉向南越，意在建成最強大的大漢王朝在一批股肱之臣紛紛下世後，武帝大膽起用漢室新一代棟樑，他們抱著新的理想，摩拳擦掌欲展開年輕一代的故事同時，武帝痛感到光陰催人，理想遠大而天不永年，對長生不老的追求也越來越急迫

programme.title: 楚喬傳
programme.desc: 南北朝西魏年間亂世混戰，大批平民在戰亂中淪為奴隸，命如草芥奴籍少女楚喬被送入人獵場供貴族娛樂射殺，幸得燕北世子燕洵與宇文玥暗中相救，隨後她被帶進權傾朝野的門閥宇文家目睹兄姐相繼慘死，立誓要帶妹妹逃出牢籠楚喬受到開明貴族宇文玥關注，被迫接受嚴厲訓練的同時，更與燕洵結下深厚友誼西魏門閥爭鬥，燕洵一家滿門被滅，深陷絕境，楚喬與他生死相守併力助他逃脫困局然而回到燕北後，燕洵野心膨脹，不惜以滿城百姓性命為代價割據稱雄楚喬在絕望中與燕洵分道揚鑣，並與力求天下一統釋奴止戈的宇文玥並肩作戰，粉碎了燕洵的復仇計劃，成為心懷蒼生的巾幗將軍權臣宇文泰也在良臣勸諫下釋放奴隸，荼毒數百年掠民為奴的暴政至此終結

programme.title: 十月圍城首
programme.desc: 1905年，香港在英國人統轄之下已度過數十個年頭，並被定名為維多利亞城華人依然佔人口極大比數，一方面保存了清朝的生活面貌，另一方面又受到西方文化的極大衝擊城中的華藉紳商，漸漸擁有財富與勢力，他們深明在英國政府管轄下，若不主動爭取，將會處處受制，但腐敗顢頇的滿清政府亦無法取得他們的信任於是，他們將希望寄託在滿懷理想，誓要推翻滿清政府的革命黨人身上

programme.title: 特殊身份
programme.desc: 陳子龍被香港警方挑選臥底混入黑社會，收集大頭目雄的犯罪情報雄的組織連連被瓦解，察覺到內部有臥底，開始展開大屠殺陳子龍怕身份被揭發，連忙找到上司張Sir，但張Sir希望他陪同最厲害的頭目Sunny去海南島暗中調查組織的犯罪行徑，以便一網打盡到了當地，陳子龍及Sunny卻被一個神秘殺手刀鋒追殺

programme.title: 高地戰
programme.desc: 韓戰停火前夕，韓方懷疑派駐關鍵前線38度線高地的特種鱷魚部隊有通敵可能，命防諜中尉姜恩彪前往調查，姜恩彪發現鱷魚部隊實際領導人竟是昔日怯懦的戰友，而看似軍紀渙散的部隊實有驚人戰力，更隱藏著眾人絕口不提的神秘事件！在參與鱷魚部隊拉鋸式的高地爭奪戰後，姜恩彪終於發現了部隊可能通敵的線索

programme.title: 寒單
programme.desc: 正月十五，炮炸寒單爺現場擠滿了人潮，肉身寒單阿義站在神轎上，威風凜凜地接受信徒丟上鞭炮轟炸忽然間，成堆的炸藥被引爆，意外造成阿義女友萱萱的死亡；不忍心看保住性命卻喪失一切的阿義墮落社會邊緣，正昆毅然放棄成為教師的機會，用盡力氣將阿義拉離地獄的深淵歃血為盟的兄弟二人，一同經營昆儀回收場，怎知當年意外的真相曝光後，兩人從此在情義的天平兩端生死掙扎，炸在身上的紋身之罪，是否能抵消深藏的錐心之痛？

programme.title: 執法先鋒

programme.title: 奇門異人
programme.desc: 民國時期，隸屬於殺手組織修羅門的冷鋼，天生具有身體金屬化特異功能，但在刺殺軍閥的行動中遭同門殺手重傷，為酒館老闆紅籮及其妹麥子所救為了報恩，冷鋼短暫留在酒館，這裡的親情和溫暖，促使冷鋼決心要回歸平凡但是與外國勢力勾結的極樂幫，卻在此時大肆拘捕具有異能的國人，風波再起，冷鋼變回令眾人聞風喪膽的修羅門殺手，一場燃爆腎上腺素的戰鬥正在展開！

programme.title: 七劍
programme.desc: 滿清入關，中原武林仍隱藏不少反抗力量，親王派前朝降清高手剿殺各地武林異議人士，重要目標便是位於西北邊陲武莊內隱藏的反清組織天地會分舵人馬路見不平的俠醫傅青主帶領兩位武莊青年上天山求助於世外高人晦明大師，晦明大師答應相助，並將畢生修為煉成的七把寶劍分贈七人，展開七劍下天山的武林傳奇其中七劍分別為：一曰莫問二曰由龍三曰青幹劍四曰競星，五曰舍神劍六曰天瀑劍七曰日月劍

programme.title: 唐伯虎點秋香
programme.desc: 姑蘇唐伯虎（周星馳飾）文名遠播某日，唐伯虎在大廟中遇見華夫人及侍婢秋香（鞏俐），一見傾心，不惜以假身分華安賣身葬父入華府為僕豈知華夫人因故痛恨唐家，並對華安之來歷起疑，幾經波折後終於識破其真實身分為唐伯虎，但仍心存刁難，且看唐伯虎能否在一班蒙面新娘中點中秋香

programme.title: S風暴
programme.desc: 廉政公署首席調查主任陸志廉接獲線報，香港賽馬會有人與外圍賭盤勾結，在他深入調查後發生多起連環兇案，此時香港警方重案組劉保強卻強行介入調查，在這之中與調查貪污的陸志廉多有摩擦然而在追查案件時，殺手犯案手法日漸兇狠，牽涉的貪污層級也越來越高，兩人不得不聯手合作，從中找尋真相

programme.title: 熱血搜救隊：翻轉世界
programme.desc: 不知哪個大壞蛋在森林灑滿了粉色粉末，這些粉末只要碰到水就會爆炸，更令人頭痛的是，一個月後雨季就要來了，屆時整座森林一定會被炸個精光！只有一個傳說級的科學家有辦法製作解藥，只是這個人在很久以前發生一場意外後便不知去向熱血搜救隊必須踏破鐵鞋，從北極到遠東，翻越高山沙漠和汪洋，尋找這個人的下落，他們有辦法找到解藥，拯救岌岌可危的森林嗎？

programme.title: 靈犬雪麗
programme.desc: 男孩小恩與爺爺住在阿爾卑斯山上一天，村民認為有隻流浪大白熊犬咬死羊隻，準備驅離牠，純真的小恩深信牠不是兇手，不僅挺身而出保護牠，更幫牠命名雪麗，一人一狗成為最佳拍檔，形影不離直到納粹德軍來到山上，雪麗因為小恩竟咬傷德軍，村民決定殺死牠小恩和雪麗能否逃過一劫，繼續守護彼此呢？

programme.title: 絕命線阱
programme.desc: 電台主持人艾維斯，總在深夜談話節目中，運用充滿魅力的嗓音，以及獨樹一格的幽默，解決聽眾四面八方的苦惱某天在節目上，他接到不明的Call In電話，歹徒表示已闖入他家，並綁架他的妻女，若不照指令行動，就會殺掉她們原以為只是惡作劇，但電話那端卻傳來妻女的求救聲！

programme.title: 魔女神兵
programme.desc: 十四世紀的法國，貝曼（尼可拉斯凱吉飾）率領一群驍勇善戰的戰士，奉命押解一名被冠以女巫之名的女子上山，交由僧侶作法驅魔經過朝夕相處，戰士們對年輕女子的罪名產生懷疑和困惑，儘管世人堅稱巫女魔力是當時黑死病肆虐的根源，但他們依舊抱有懷疑勇士們遊走於任務與正義之間，友誼也因此受到空前考驗

programme.title: 玩命快遞：肆意橫行
programme.desc: 法蘭克馬丁卸下特務身分後，轉行成為地表最強送貨員，他的客戶通常是身分可疑的危險人物，不過他從不過問交易細節拿錢辦事而且絕對使命必達當退休的特工老爸來到南法找他時，原以為可以再續父子天倫之樂，沒想到老爸卻涉入蛇蠍美女安娜與其美麗同夥策劃的銀行搶案，法蘭克必須用他非凡身手與飛車絕技，救回最珍貴的家人！

programme.title: 詐欺女王首
programme.desc: 瑪拉利用法律手段，將特定老人族群當成目標，先成為其法定監護人，讓他們住進護理機構，再封鎖對外求助管道，最後偷走他們的財產，不動聲色地完美犯案某天，她鎖定下一個肥羊，成功讓對方掉入自己精心佈下的騙局隨後，她竟發現這位看似完美的肥羊，似乎不如表面所見的那樣單純？

programme.title: 製騙追殺令
programme.desc: 一棟殺氣重重的成人片製片廠，一場緊張又荒謬的生存之戰即將展開！阿奇斯是個常進出監獄的小混混，在前獄友強力邀約下出演假影片來挽救一名富豪的商譽殺青後，阿奇斯居然成為黑幫大哥出身的導演要刪除的角色！？被困在成人片製片廠的他無所不用其極，牙刷道具竟成了他的防身武器，現在他欠的是生機！

programme.title: 玩命鎗火
programme.desc: 波士頓一處廢棄倉庫，軍火仲介賈斯汀安排一場軍火買賣她帶著仲裁人歐德愛爾蘭買家克里斯及法蘭克到場，打算跟黑道軍火商維農購買軍火然而在交易過程中，他們發現貨品有誤，外加雙方私人恩怨，讓一個擦鎗走火的意外事件，導致整場談判破局，展開鎗林彈雨的瘋狂對幹，而這個脫序的倉庫生存大逃殺，究竟誰能活到最後一刻？

programme.title: 好萊塢幕後解密新
programme.desc: 好萊塢幕後解密新

programme.title: 龍轉戰局
programme.desc: 人類生存的希望寄託在傳說中滅絕的生物！一個孤獨的騎士試圖組建一支軍隊來對抗惡魔領主，傳說中的巨龍是他們抵禦的最後希望，但這種生物真的存在嗎？如果是這樣，牠會再次為人民而戰嗎？

programme.title: 前線狙擊手
programme.desc: 1943年末，納粹派出訓練有素的狙擊手進入到前線，帶來了破壞和死亡，被圍困的蘇聯士兵已經堅守保衛了國家兩年年輕又天賦異稟的獵人葉戈爾受到徵召挺身對抗入侵者，雖然年輕又缺乏戰鬥經驗，葉戈爾仍以過人的技能和勇氣，證明自己在前線有能力扮演扭轉戰局至關重要的角色

programme.title: 鋼鐵勳章
programme.desc: 金獎卡司集結，真人真事震撼改編，見證史上最偉大的鋼鐵英雄！威廉皮森伯格是越戰空降救援醫療兵，在戰場上展現無私大愛，解救數十位弟兄後光榮犧牲，而原定頒發予這位戰爭英雄的國會榮譽勳章，卻基於某些政治遭到撤回五角大廈調查員史考特霍夫曼（賽巴斯汀史坦飾）在調查這件不公事件的過程中，親自拜訪當年戰役中的生還者們，大家團結一心，為皮森伯格爭取他應得的榮譽

programme.title: 鎖命佈局
programme.desc: 門羅家族是有權有勢的上流家族某天，大家長突然逝世，並留下鉅額遺產然而在分配遺產時，女兒蘿倫卻只分到一萬美金與一個牛皮紙袋，紙袋中裝有一把鑰匙，以及父親生前所錄下的一段影片，並告訴她：有些秘密，必須要帶入墳墓在好奇心的驅使之下，蘿倫用那把鑰匙打開了庭院的鐵門

programme.title: 放牛班足球隊
programme.desc: 瑪麗娜是位相當不尋常的修女，她來到一所學校任職，學校收容許多單親失親的孩子她被分配到最不喜歡讀書的放牛班，孩子們一如既往地調皮搗蛋，想要逼退瑪麗娜修女儘管如此，瑪麗娜有個想法，想組建一支足球隊，幫助孩子們找到學習的重心

programme.title: 下一站，托斯卡尼
programme.desc: 一位畫家，帶著他關係疏遠的兒子，兩人從倫敦返回義大利，想出售已故妻子多年前一起生活過的房子不過這棟房子年久失修，客廳牆壁還有一大片難以理解的彩繪，導致完全沒人想買下這棟房子兩人只好試圖與當地居民，一同運用手邊僅有的工具，開始修繕這棟老舊房屋同時，這對父子也沒想到，當他們放下繁忙生活，來到義大利托斯卡尼鄉間，似乎也開始找到屬於他們的未來

programme.title: 絕命3小時
programme.desc: 曾是歷史地標的堡高醫院，荒廢已久並面臨即將拆除的命運，但某幫派卻在此藏了九千萬，隨著消息傳開，兩個敵對黑幫虎視眈眈，想要找出這筆贓款，未料卻被拆除工人麥可搶先發現，而距離建物爆破拆除期限僅剩短短三小時

programme.title: 星光首映場詐欺女王
programme.desc: 瑪拉利用法律手段，將特定老人族群當成目標，先成為其法定監護人，讓他們住進護理機構，再封鎖對外求助管道，最後偷走他們的財產，不動聲色地完美犯案某天，她鎖定下一個肥羊，成功讓對方掉入自己精心佈下的騙局隨後，她竟發現這位看似完美的肥羊，似乎不如表面所見的那樣單純？

programme.title: 報告班長3
programme.desc: 在一次突擊式的模擬軍事演習中，蘇班長率小穎等眾兵戍海岸線，準備殲滅登陸的藍軍，不料小穎誤觸引爆炸藥的按鈕，而將演習弄得一團亂，全連也因此被派赴基地再訓練負責訓練的屠班長暗下決定，一切要從頭開始烏龍班終於在營裡舉行成果驗收之日，展現最亮麗的一面，也在五項戰技測驗中為連長奪下一面獎牌

programme.title: 2001太空漫遊
programme.desc: 伴隨著查拉圖斯特拉如是說而緩緩昇起的太陽，當四百萬年前黑石碑出現在地球，原始人類觸摸後開始會使用工具，人類就此開始進化，而那根象徵要主宰世界為慶祝勝利而被拋向空中的獸骨，鏡頭一轉來到現代成了一艘宇宙飛船，襯托著小約翰史特勞斯的古典名曲藍色多瑙河，與太空站翩翩起舞航向未知的領域

programme.title: 霍元甲之精武天下
programme.desc: 清朝末年，八國聯軍入侵後，日軍趁機進駐天津開設武館，展開征服中國的第一步此舉激發了天津習武之人的愛國意識，一代宗師霍元甲將代表天津的武者們，接受日本武術的挑戰，守護鄉里眾人的尊嚴

programme.title: 吊人索
programme.desc: 退休警官杰德庫柏來到西部購買一批牲口準備務農，卻被一群以退役上尉威爾遜為首自稱為民除害的槍手，指控其謀殺及偷竊牛隻，而私下對他處以絞刑庫柏瀕死之際被經過的法警救下，而真實的犯案者也在事後被逮，法官除還庫柏清白外，更力邀庫柏重回警職擔任警長，成為美國西部聯邦法警庫柏決心整治濫用私刑問題為嫌犯爭取公平審判，並將那班原欲吊死他的惡徒一一繩之以法

programme.title: 狄仁傑之九層妖樓
programme.desc: 涼州府唐家九層妖樓接連出現恐怖怪狀，還嚇瘋了周邊的葛大爺，令九層妖樓鬧妖事件一時之間傳得沸沸揚揚，人心浮動為安撫人心，狄仁傑先是醫治好葛大爺，又親自前往唐家，向家主唐志遠詢問探查唐志遠卻含糊其辭，神色怪異，引起狄仁傑的懷疑剛離開唐府，便被唐家大小姐唐慕卿的侍女畫兒悄悄塞了封求救信

programme.title: 追緝開膛手
programme.desc: 名偵探與法醫在維多利亞時代的倫敦聯手解謎一樁連環謀殺案，他們必須深入倫敦的黑暗之心，尋找真正的兇手

programme.title: 午夜密令
programme.desc: 1939年夏天，一間位在英國南部海岸專收納粹高官女兒的奧古斯塔維多利亞女子學院，嚴格遵循著希特勒的納粹思想英籍校長羅喬爾僱用英籍教師湯瑪斯米勒作為臨時教師；湯瑪斯並在校長與其他德籍教師們的監視下，教導這群女孩練習英語這時，校園中出現一位前任教師的屍體，也讓湯瑪斯陷入致命危機

programme.title: 大不列顛之戰
programme.desc: 二戰初期，在歐陸發動閃電戰術的納粹德軍大獲全勝，而英軍經歷了敦克爾克大撤退後，裝備短缺信心動搖希特勒向英國喊話勸降，否則將進行攻占；英國首相邱吉爾隨即在下議院發表演說，大不列顛之戰正式展開最終英國皇家空軍靠著有限戰機與靈活戰術，力抗德軍優勢的空中武力，讓希特勒首度嚐到挫敗，適時阻止納粹入侵英國的野心

programme.title: 蘇乞兒之武功蓋世
programme.desc: 蘇燦出生於軍官家庭，自幼酷愛武術，進京趕武，卻遭禁毒陷害，家破人亡清朝末年，廣東十虎蘇乞兒決戰斧頭幫與江湖大盜，最後創立門派

programme.title: 大洪荒
programme.desc: 公元前百萬年的遠古時代，高原洞穴中的岩石部落，首領阿可荷巴的次子托馬克因不服父親搶奪自己的食物而遭驅逐，流浪至海邊被較文明的貝殼族所救他因奮勇擊退巨獸而為貝殼族所擁戴，並受該族美女羅安納仰慕，而後率領貝殼族人歷經千辛萬苦回到岩石部落，卻人事已非其兄長沙卡納謀害父親並繼任成為新的首領，而高原上的火山也即將爆發

programme.title: 黃飛鴻三之獅王爭霸
programme.desc: 黃飛鴻偕同十三姨梁寬赴京城與父親黃麒英相敘，並協助開辦寶之林藥廠事宜獅王大會即將舉行，惡霸趙天霸視黃飛鴻為大患，邀黃飛鴻談判時設下重重陷阱欲置黃死地，幸虧黃麒英一干人趕到支援，解除困境趙霸天咄咄逼人，逼使黃飛鴻不能袖手旁觀，決定挺身而出，阻止趙天霸此等敗類奪取獅王美名

programme.title: 超級中國龍
programme.desc: 朱事丁是電子遊戲機迷，某日撿到一張來歷不明的電腦光碟，竟與哥哥朱事文雙雙被吸入電腦遊戲－黃金島歷險記的世界中，兩兄弟不但身處黃金島，更誤闖進島主小龍和海盜船長的鬥爭中

programme.title: 飛行世紀
programme.desc: 二十世紀初萊特兄弟成功實現了人類飛行的夢想，英國每日郵報主編羅恩斯利為了彰顯大不列顛帝國的種族優越，便策劃了一場從倫敦飛往巴黎的飛行競賽，但他其實私下盤算讓準女婿梅斯贏得比賽來自世界各地的飛行愛好者帶著自己的愛機湧入倫敦參加比賽，此時邪惡的波西先生和助手卻開始進行破壞和作弊計畫這場冒險者的比賽，意外發展成了一場爭奪羅恩斯利女兒帕崔夏的愛情大賽！

programme.title: 死亡塔
programme.desc: 一代宗師李振強和武林高手秦谷是生死之交，秦谷的猝逝讓李振強決心找到背後的真兇，卻不幸遇害，只留下了一個和死亡塔有關的秘密振強的弟弟振國得知兄長死訊後，追隨着振強留下的線索來到神秘山莊內潛藏的宮殿，等待著他的竟然是正是秦谷，原來振強與振國都落入了秦谷一手策劃的陰謀漩渦之中

programme.title: 戰略大作戰
programme.desc: 二戰盟軍在法國南部遭遇德軍頑強抵抗，美軍偵察前鋒部隊擄獲一名德軍情報局上校為長官背黑鍋而被拔除中尉官階的士兵凱利，灌醉上校後套出德軍藏匿大筆金條要後送柏林，於是開始招兵買馬說服隊上弟兄長官，準備利用即將到來的三天假期，進行一場神不知鬼不覺的敵後奪寶大作戰！

programme.title: 燦爛的遺產
programme.desc: 李昇基韓孝珠經典代表作！灰姑娘逆襲無賴王子 高恩星在母親因病去世後，從此多了一個沒有血緣關係的妹妹柳承美繼母城府極深，表面上對恩星姐弟關愛有加，但卻是個非常愛錢的女人恩星的父親公司破產，且不慎遭搶劫，搶匪戴著他的物品在火災中喪生繼母誤認死者為丈夫，領取巨額保險金後將恩星姊弟趕出門恩星偶然救了食品公司社長張淑子，而得到工作，然而張淑子竟然說要把財產全留給恩星，還說要切斷金孫于煥所有的經濟來源為了逆轉這種情況，于煥只好跟仇人般的恩星一起工作，卻發現自己逐漸喜歡上恩星

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 李浚赫化身金家小兒子 婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 財閥家的小兒子
programme.desc: 年度收視冠軍！宋仲基轉生財閥金孫 上演經營權大戰出生貧寒的尹炫優，任職於順陽集團風險管理的秘書室長，對公司忠心耿耿，只要高層下達命令絕對使命必達，某天被指派回收秘密資金的任務，卻被集團誣陷私吞資金慘遭滅口再度睜開眼睛時，他回到了1987年，成為順陽集團的財閥金孫陳導俊，並利用前生的記憶，他將找出殺害他的兇手，更要加入繼承權爭奪戰，一步步併吞集團，成為順陽的新主人

programme.title: 男朋友雙語版
programme.desc: 韓版羅馬假期 霸總宋慧喬戀上暖男朴寶劍 出身政客家庭的車秀賢，為了家族犧牲愛情步入無愛的婚姻，離婚後的人生空虛蒼白；金振赫是懷抱夢想的平凡青年，用熱情擁抱世界兩人在異國邂逅，相知相愛，卻因身分懸殊而痛苦分離多年後重逢，她已是冷靜自持的上司，他是剛入職的新進員工過往的甜蜜與傷痕浮現，情感再度悄然蔓延她掙扎於曾經的選擇，他則努力衝破階級的枷鎖愛情，能否再次在現實的夾縫中綻放？

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 李浚赫化身金家小兒子 婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.desc: 年度收視冠軍！宋仲基轉生財閥金孫 上演經營權大戰出生貧寒的尹炫優，任職於順陽集團風險管理的秘書室長，對公司忠心耿耿，只要高層下達命令絕對使命必達，某天被指派回收秘密資金的任務，卻被集團誣陷私吞資金慘遭滅口再度睜開眼睛時，他回到了1987年，成為順陽集團的財閥金孫陳導俊，並利用前生的記憶，他將找出殺害他的兇手，更要加入繼承權爭奪戰，一步步併吞集團，成為順陽的新主人

programme.title: 男朋友雙語版
programme.desc: 韓版羅馬假期 霸總宋慧喬戀上暖男朴寶劍 出身政客家庭的車秀賢，為了家族犧牲愛情步入無愛的婚姻，離婚後的人生空虛蒼白；金振赫是懷抱夢想的平凡青年，用熱情擁抱世界兩人在異國邂逅，相知相愛，卻因身分懸殊而痛苦分離多年後重逢，她已是冷靜自持的上司，他是剛入職的新進員工過往的甜蜜與傷痕浮現，情感再度悄然蔓延她掙扎於曾經的選擇，他則努力衝破階級的枷鎖愛情，能否再次在現實的夾縫中綻放？

programme.title: 燦爛的遺產
programme.desc: 李昇基韓孝珠經典代表作！灰姑娘逆襲無賴王子 高恩星在母親因病去世後，從此多了一個沒有血緣關係的妹妹柳承美繼母城府極深，表面上對恩星姐弟關愛有加，但卻是個非常愛錢的女人恩星的父親公司破產，且不慎遭搶劫，搶匪戴著他的物品在火災中喪生繼母誤認死者為丈夫，領取巨額保險金後將恩星姊弟趕出門恩星偶然救了食品公司社長張淑子，而得到工作，然而張淑子竟然說要把財產全留給恩星，還說要切斷金孫于煥所有的經濟來源為了逆轉這種情況，于煥只好跟仇人般的恩星一起工作，卻發現自己逐漸喜歡上恩星

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 李浚赫化身金家小兒子 婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 財閥家的小兒子
programme.desc: 年度收視冠軍！宋仲基轉生財閥金孫 上演經營權大戰出生貧寒的尹炫優，任職於順陽集團風險管理的秘書室長，對公司忠心耿耿，只要高層下達命令絕對使命必達，某天被指派回收秘密資金的任務，卻被集團誣陷私吞資金慘遭滅口再度睜開眼睛時，他回到了1987年，成為順陽集團的財閥金孫陳導俊，並利用前生的記憶，他將找出殺害他的兇手，更要加入繼承權爭奪戰，一步步併吞集團，成為順陽的新主人

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋
programme.desc: 狠心母拋家嫁富豪 棄子重生 只為揭穿母親真面目一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與繼孫女的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決

programme.title: 歐若拉公主
programme.desc: 落難千金嫁到三位惡婆婆家，受盡欺辱卻迷的兩位男神團團轉！該劇以豪爽純潔的愛情故事繼續展開，故事發生在大公司名門之女歐若拉遇見與三個姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小說家黃瑪瑪

programme.title: 燦爛的風和海
programme.desc: 賽車手失意澳門邂逅冷豔策展人共度浪漫情緣在燈火輝煌的攝影棚與璀璨奪目的澳門之間，廣告導演麥又歌為夢想與責任奔波，結識熱心單純的機車青年徐君樂，在彼此的陪伴下逐漸打開封閉的心門同時，賽車手韓俊豪在失利陰影與媒體質疑中掙扎，卻因邂逅神秘策展人陳嘉慧，而重新燃起追尋自我的勇氣四人在工作夢想與愛情的交織裡相遇，既面對現實的壓力，也學會傾聽心底的渴望在陌生卻絢爛的城市裡，他們將一同經歷命運的考驗，找尋屬於自己的方向

programme.title: 抓住你的衣領
programme.desc: 改編榮獲韓國網路小說懸疑類大獎，熱血記者金荷娜攜手前男友延玗臻聯手調查！擅長挖掘獨家新聞的女記者徐貞媛，除事業上的成功，與作家丈夫薛宇宰的幸福婚後生活也令人稱羨某日在犯罪現場成為了目擊者，隨著越演越烈的風波被懷疑為殺人犯，爲證明自己的清白而向刑警前男友泰憲尋求幫助，聯手找尋真相

programme.title: 飛龍猛將粵
programme.desc: 律師約翰成龍 飾受聘於一間以化學原料廠偽裝的毒品工廠,負責收購附近的一個漁場,約翰透過經紀飛洪洪金寶 飾進行游說,從而結識漁場主人的表妹美玲楊寶玲 飾,正當收購完成前,飛洪發現了化學原料廠製毒的秘密而被捉,使約翰亦陷於危難.

programme.title: 長江7號粵普
programme.desc: 周鐵在一個建築工地當臨時工,以微薄的收入供兒子周小迪念當地的一所貴族學校.由於小迪家境貧寒,他經常受到同學們的嘲笑和欺負,然而他謹記父親的教誨,不卑不亢.還時常幫助學校中的弱勢群體,也由此得到了一位體型巨大的女同學美嬌的好感.小迪看見同學的先進玩具長江一號,自己也愛不釋手,逼迫父親購買.周鐵雖當面拒絕,卻覺得心中有愧.在他外出為兒子撿一雙運動鞋時,無意間撿到了外星船遺留在地球上的類似橡皮...

programme.title: 英雄本色粵

programme.title: 意外人生普

programme.title: 情聖粵
programme.desc: 程勝周星馳本是騙子一名,為人機靈熱心,極受女孩歡迎.他與女騙徒葉圓毛舜筠相遇,程勝被誤作為盲人,程勝乃予以訛騙.後因見葉圓被追債,挺身相助,而為她負了一身債.老江湖周潤發午馬因欠下貴利王張耀揚債,被逼去向一富豪詐騙.偶然下周潤發認定程勝就是該富豪,程勝乃將計就計反騙周潤發.最後大家卻發現各人都欠下貴利王巨債,乃合力對抗貴利王.

programme.title: 鈕扣人粵普
programme.desc: 在街頭生存就不能有所牽絆, 否則無法脫身的將會是自己.錯手抑或是蓄意安排,殺人後為了不留後患,總是要有人善後.偉是幫會的鈕扣人,一個替社團清理兇殺案現場,毀屍滅跡的專業高手.他沒想到自己有一天竟也成為同行清單上的目標......

programme.title: 甜絲絲粵普

programme.title: 人皮燈籠粵普

programme.title: 美男子粵普
programme.desc: 二世祖劉定標有南獅和北獅妻妾二人,終日爭吵不休.劉欲移民,但移民局不批准兩妻同住.劉找好友Richard幫忙,要他暫時選一妻結婚,日後再將妻子還給他,Richard以事出荒唐而拒絕.Richard為物理治療師,有交往多年的女友May,但他不欲受婚姻束縛,訛稱已婚.May舊男友Johnny回港,再度向May追求.Richard不欲失去May,要護士伍姑娘扮其妻,劉扮姦夫,上演一幕休妻記,再向M...

programme.title: 大丈夫粵普
programme.desc: 一個炎熱的夏天,四名男子:郭天佑,李永祥,徐嬌及洪國波突然不約而同離開工作崗位,換上他們絕少穿著的黑色西裝,駕著絕不起眼的普通的士,準備進行一項神秘行動-14小時的偷食大行動...

programme.title: 奇謀妙計五福星粵
programme.desc: 茶壺,死氣喉,凡士林,鬈毛積及劉克司五人出獄後決定改邪歸正,與鬈毛積的妹妹妹頭同組五寶清潔公司.某次匪徒正交易偽鈔電版時遇上劫匪,剛巧被 CID 看見便一路追趕,後劫匪情急下將電版拋進五福星之清潔車中.五寶開始被兩大反派追殺,最後五福星施展奇謀妙計應付兩大反派.

programme.title: 大隻佬粵
programme.desc: 身材壯碩武藝超凡的武僧大隻佬劉德華飾在逃離探員李鳳儀張栢芝飾的追捕期間,遇上警犬,同時在警犬身後見到小童追打狗隻的影像,警犬隨即被追捕歹徒的警員誤射死亡.大隻佬首次展現他看到因果的能力,接着,又在李身後看到日軍屠殺平民的影像.大隻佬見李鳳儀生性善良,決定幫助李查一宗兇殺案,但誓言破案後,兩人便如同陌路.大隻佬在房中查看過屍首後,再次展現能看到過去的能力,稱之為看到因果.死者過...

programme.title: 猛龍粵普
programme.desc: 香港警員阿樂,阿雪與年青國際刑警聯手押運極度重犯段邊豹,卻在途中被劫犯者劫走.國際刑警被勒令不准在香港執法,並交由老差骨江龍監察.決意收山的江龍被他們的鬥志打動,並肩剷除國際悍匪,決戰一觸即發...

programme.title: 監獄風雲II之逃犯粵
programme.desc: 資深囚犯鍾天正當初因為誤殺妻子而入獄,服刑期間母親病逝,兒子良仔被送到孤兒院甚至對父親產生怨恨.鍾天正一心想申請外出看望兒子,卻遭到監獄保安組主任仇Sir的諸多刁難.他因收買獄中大陸幫首領龐飛龍不成,把龐飛龍視為眼中釘,並且從中唆使挑撥使得龐飛龍與鍾天正之間產生隔閡,並利用香港幫和大圈幫犯人之間的摩擦,作為控制秩序的手段.一次在廁所裏械鬥的陷害使得龐飛龍不得不逃獄實為骷髏頭出賣...

programme.title: 野獸之瞳粵
programme.desc: 賀瞳古天樂 飾和賀沖吳彥祖 飾是一對關係疏離的孿生兄弟.哥哥阿瞳是一個活潑外向的聰明孩子,而沖則完全相反,害羞內向.在他二十六歲生日那天,沖收到了哥哥去世的消息,驚詫的他開始調查哥哥的神秘死亡.在阿瞳的家裏,沖遇上了瞳生前的女友阿陸谷祖琳 飾和最好的朋友阿Man譚耀文 飾.沖最終發現瞳的死是因為在一場拳擊比賽中拒絕打假拳.日子漸長,沖漸漸喜歡上阿陸,而與此同時開始着手為哥哥的...

programme.title: 大上海粵
programme.desc: 故事開始於20世紀10年代,上海浦東長大的小子成大器,在生果店工作,勤懇好學.大器喜歡鄰居的京劇演員葉知秋.知秋自小漂亮出眾,跟父親學刀馬旦,一心在舞台上出人頭地.兩人青梅竹馬,甚是甜蜜.可惜好景不常,生果店老闆娘與警察局長私通,卻被水果店老闆撞破.局長於是誣陷大器殺害老闆,慘被判監.幸在獄中,得到國民黨的特務茅載救他脫險,大器遂蒼皇逃走.葉知秋一直等不到大器消息,只好隻身赴北平學藝,兩人從...

programme.desc: Malik

programme.title: Eat, Fun Pray

programme.desc: Boss, Tina, JJ, Dez and Pip willfully get babysat by the Uncuddleables, planning to expose them as horrible sitters via secret, hidden cameras. But the plan is thrown for a loop when Tinas first night alone without her parents makes her fall for their sitter Mia as a substitute mommy. Meanwhile, Nannycam uses the babysitting distraction to sneak into the Uncuddleables secret garage hideout to gather intel with her own B field team.

programme.title: The Big Dumpling
programme.desc: The Uncuddleables have struck the Lil Dumpling baby pageant, replacing all of Baby Corps super-cute top 5er babies with not-cute bottom 5ers. Boss, Tina and their field team race to caravan the 5ers from their homes to the pageant before Nannycam deploys the nuclear option of unleashing the dangerously cute UBO on stage to salvage a Lil Dumpling win.

programme.title: Rafaelas Raf-venge
programme.desc: The team realizes that theyre being led on a wild goose chase and that the person behind it all must be the one and only Rafaela! Shes broken out of prison and is now causing havoc in Berlin using the dangerous stolen spy tech which makes her more formidable that ever before.

programme.title: Fun on the Autobahn
programme.desc: The search for the Incineration Day tech continues and Frostee thinks hes finally figured out whos behind the whole thing: his little sister, Sissy! Unfortunately, his theory is quickly debunked when Sissy and his moms are kidnapped by the actual bad guys culminating in an epic race down the Autobahn to save Frostees family!

programme.title: Detonation
programme.desc: Ciscos been kidnapped! The team scrambles to get him back, but Tony and Echo disagree on the best plan of action.

programme.title: Unholy Dragon Returns to the Mountains
programme.desc: Jindiao takes Po and the kids hostage in an attempt to locate the Wellspring

programme.title: Sacrifice at the Edge of Time
programme.desc: The kids are desperate to get back and help their fellow Panda Villagers, and Po decides he must figure out a way to defeat Jindiao before he controls the world

programme.title: End of the Dragon Master
programme.desc: Po, the kids, and the new Panda Guardians must work together to defeat Jindiao once and for all, and get a visit from an unlikely source

programme.title: The Night Lights: Part 1
programme.desc: Tom and Thunder discover a baby Nightlight and must bring him back to Thunders home realm.

programme.title: The Night Lights: Part 2
programme.desc: When Thunders clan of fellow Nightlights is attacked by the Snow Wraith, Tom vows to rescue them.

programme.title: Dreadtrux Part 1
programme.desc: The Dinotrux investigate when all of the other trux in the crater start running away from a mysterious mountain that may be coming alive.

programme.title: Dreadtrux Part 2
programme.desc: With the mighty Dreadtrux threatening to destroy the crater, Ty considers working with D-Structs to save both of their homes.

programme.title: Si
programme.desc: Puss fights the Duchess to retrieve the first coin he ever took from the Treasure House, which can help him restore San Lorenzos protective spell.

programme.title: No
programme.desc: Puss in Boots returns to San Lorenzo at the behest of Dulcinea, to flush out an imposter masquerading as the towns protector.

programme.title: Digglys Big Adventure
programme.desc: Diggly is bored of life on his compost heap and wants to see round the rest of the garden. Fifi offers to give him a guided tour. Diggly gets lost, how will he get home?

programme.title: Pips Playground
programme.desc: Pip is feeling bored and wants something new to play. Fifi has a brilliant idea and asks all the tots to help her build a playground for Pip as a surprise.

programme.title: Mud Sculptures
programme.desc: It has been raining and the garden is muddy. The tots decide to make mud sculptures. But what will they all do with the sculptures when they are finished?

programme.title: Stingos Naughty Day
programme.desc: Stingo is bored and plays all manner of naughty tricks on the other tots. Fifi teaches Stingo that he will have more fun if he helps people rather than being mean to them.

programme.title: Shrinking Pip
programme.desc: The Tots are all measuring themselves. Pip hasnt grown much since he was last measured. How can he grow into a big strong gooseberry?

programme.title: Bumbles Special Lunch
programme.desc: Fifi has invited the other tots over to lunch but she is not very well. Bumble gamely steps in and offers to cook for her. What could possibly go wrong?

programme.title: Harmony Harbors Holiday Surprise
programme.desc: When the townsfolk decorate the Harmony Harbor holiday tree but lose the treetop star, TZG secretly search for it in the yard of a notoriously scary house. When it transpires the house is not-so-scary after all and belongs to shy inventor Dr. Greenlittle, TZG secretly leads her to the big Harmony Harbor sing-along so that she doesnt have to spend the holiday alone.

programme.title: The Big Sleep-Walk Of Course You Can
programme.desc: When Ian starts to sleepwalk around Harmony Harbor, TZG secretly guides him back to his own bed where he can continue sleeping safely. When Felicia wants to run an obstacle course for the first time but is afraid shell embarrass herself, TZG secretly boosts her confidence by helping with practice.

programme.title: Olivia Trains Her Cat
programme.desc: When Olivias class holds a pet talent show, nobody can beat Francines amazingly talented cat Gwendolyn. Olivias lethargic cat Edwin, who barely moves, suddenly goes missing. Olivia then fancies herself a cat detective as shetracks down the missing cat.

programme.title: Olivias Lemonade Stand
programme.desc: Olivias lemonade stand is losing customers to Francines pink lemonade stand. Olivia does her one better by opening up her own full-scale backyard restaurant, imagining its a fabulous supper club. But Olivia soon finds that her restaurant needs something she can only get from Francine something pink!

programme.title: Olivia Takes A Road Trip
programme.desc: On the looooong drive to Grandmas house, Olivia finds ways to pass the time. She imagines her family traveling in style, as she pilots her very own jumbo jetOlivia Air! By the time they arrive at Grandmas, Olivias had so much fun that the discomfort of the road trip has been forgotten.

programme.title: Olivia Goes International
programme.desc: When asked to give a presentation for her classs International Day. Olivia cant decide which country to choose. Being Olivia she invents her own country Olivitania -where cupcakes are the national food and the national anthem sounds suspiciously like Puccini.

programme.title: Monster Movie Quacky Duck
programme.desc: Monster Movie Casper and Jimmy want to enter the Deedstown Horror Movie festival by making their own scary movie after all, who better to make a monster movie then real monsters? When Thatch destroys the master copy the little monsters hopes are dashed until clever Casper realises that real monsters can still present a movie, in REAL 3D Quacky Duck A cute little plastic bath duck finds it way into Scare School. Everyone is horrified, its FAR too cute! Whoevers brought it to school must

programme.title: Dopplegangers Totally Bats!
programme.desc: Dopplegangers The little monsters are excited because the headmasters have given them a special zapppy control device which can make them transform into anything. They demonstrate it by turning themselves into each other. Cool! Say the kids. Casper heads straight to Jimmys in order to play a trick on his friend but it goes badly wrong when Graham thinks Casper really IS his son Jimmy and takes him off to a TV show where Jimmys supposed to on a Quiz. Jimmys expert topic is computers Casp

programme.title: Tree Troubles Missing Pieces
programme.desc: When Marcus brings home the class tree sapling for the weekend, the Dew Drops see it starting to wilt and must cheer the sapling up, so Marcus can make sure to plant it for his class. When Athena accidentally breaks Lolas nature sculpture, the Dew Drops must go on a scavenger hunt to replace the missing pieces.

programme.title: The Ticket Trail Flying Solo
programme.desc: Lola, Dylan and Cassie have tickets to the carnival, but when Dylan loses his ticket, the Dew Drops set out to find it. When Phoebe accidentally gets tossed into Nicholas diaper bag before a trip to the park, Phoebe has to help a baby bird, while Eden and Athena must help Marcus rehearse for his big concert.

programme.title: Spinny Water Kelps Song
programme.desc: Kelp and his underwater friends race around an obstacle course, but Cruz gets sucked into a whirlpool. As each of them try to rescue him, they are sucked in! Kelp saves them all using his unicorn spark to create bubbles he attaches to seaweed. Kelp helps his unicorn friends create music with their horns and pieces of nature. Ollie is embarrassed by the sound of his horn.

programme.title: Playground Sparkless
programme.desc: Cruz decides to turn the sunken ship into a park. But all his and Kelps fun-crastinating puts the project in jeopardy. Kelp accidentally knocks a boulder into the stream, blocking the flow while trying his unicorn spark. Frustrated by magic, Kelp uses the narwhal way.

programme.title: Pupcakes Stink or Swim
programme.desc: When Tag discovers that Scooch is a great baker, she encourages him to start a pupcake stand. But when Tag rounds up more customers than Scooch is prepared to handle, Scooch cant keep up with the demand. Tag and Scoochs race to pick up the most trash on Pawston Beach is thwarted by Frank and Beans, who just want to make more of a mess.

programme.title: A Ball-For-All
programme.desc: Its Ball-entines Day, the day when the dogs of Pawston show their affection for each other by exchanging balls. But unfortunately, the town is fresh out, so Tag and Scooch set sail for Ball Island. If Tag and Scooch want to leave Ball Island with the balls they chose for their family, they must earn them by proving themselves ball-worthy, through a series of challenges from The Fetcher.

programme.title: The Nest
programme.desc: When the Rescue Riders save Viking chief Duggard, theyre invited to visit his village of Huttsgalor, where they must prove theyre kind and helpful.

programme.title: Deep Trouble
programme.desc: Daks lack of planning gets him, Cutter and Winger lost with Elbone in the Maze Caves, and Leylas overthinking threatens the effort to rescue them.

programme.title: A Tale of Two Kitties
programme.desc: Alex is mistaken for a Maine Coon and takes over that cats life in the penthouse. At first, VERY comfortable with his shmancy new life, Alex grows to miss his old life and learns that its lonely at the top.

programme.title: Fire Marshal Melman
programme.desc: On Junior Marshals Day at the fire station, Melman gets stuck in a firetruck on its way to a real emergency. With Alexs help, Melman must overcome his fear of heights to help save a stuck cat, and learn that even heroes get scared sometimes.

programme.title: A New Bergen-Ning Laugh Out Cloud
programme.desc: Poppy throws a party to urge the Trolls and Bergens to build friendship When Troll Village has a drought Cloud Guy offers to wash away the problem after some quality time with Branch.

programme.title: Two Party System Fun Branch
programme.desc: Poppy discovers that Branch and Bridgets birthdays are on the same day and throws them both partiesBranch attempts to prove to the Snack Pack that he is fun.

programme.title: Worst In Show
programme.desc: The gang competes to see who can best train a Terrible Terror, while Alvin is closing in on Berk.

programme.title: Appetite for Destruction
programme.desc: When different species of dragons are found on Dragon Island, the kids suspect that the Screaming Death might be back and its up to an unlikely hero to save the day.

programme.title: Palomino Bluffs Riding Academy
programme.desc: On their first day at Palomino Bluffs, the girls are determined to make a good impression. Cue the beachfront race and a daring rescue!

programme.title: The Neighs Have It
programme.desc: The PALs run into their old rivals the BUDs on the first day of classes, prompting Lucky to run for class rep. Elsewhere, Abigail helps solve a mystery.

programme.title: Queen Of Police Roidian Prom
programme.desc: When Tip takes over Kyles job as King of Police, she removes all rules from Boovsland and it descends into chaos Tip and Oh accompany DieAnne to Roidian Prom

programme.title: Where The Koobish Roam Best Friendiversary
programme.desc: On a Koobish cattle drive together, Tip and Krunkles differences result in Oh and the herd getting lost in a stampede Tip and Oh cant agree on how to celebrate their Friendiversary

programme.title: A Cause for The Paws
programme.desc: Po, at the top of his game but lonely, comes across two weasels stealing an earthquake causing gauntlet and tries to stop them, but inadvertently destroys a town. He loses his title as Dragon Master and teams up with Wandering Blade, a knight on a mission from England, to track down the weasels and get his title back.

programme.title: The Knights Code
programme.desc: Po and Blades personalities clash as they track Klaus and Veruca and fight off some of Pos old foes. Blade gets to see Pos kung fu mastery, but doesnt agree to team up with him until she realizes that he accidentally holds the key to finding Klaus and Veruca: he has a piece of the WuGao Gauntlet. Meanwhile, Klaus and Veruca continue on their path of destruction while looking for the mysterious Lotus.

programme.title: The Lotus
programme.desc: Pos moral lines are blurred when he and Blade have to break an untrustworthy hedgehog monk Zhen out of jail to get more information on what Klaus and Veruca stole from the Lotus. They learn from Zhen that there are in fact three more weapons, and Po recognizes one of them from a comic book.

programme.title: Alphabout
programme.desc: Trained by her parents, Eep competes in Alphafight-- a tournament where the animal kingdom fights to determine the dominant species. But when Eep learns that a human winning could upset the balance of nature, she must choose between winning to make her parents proud, and losing to protect the other animals.

programme.title: Bad Luck Moon Rising
programme.desc: Phil and Guy try to disprove the Croods belief that leaving offerings to the fire moon will prevent bad luck. But when their efforts seem to cause a series of mishaps, theyll have to retrieve the horn of a dangerous ramaconda to turntheir luck around.

programme.title: Beardfoot
programme.desc: Upset that he cant grow a beard, Grug resorts to some unorthodox hair growth methods. But when Phils experimental hair formula makes fur grow all over Grugs body, he flees to the woods to avoid the other farm residents attempts to shave him.

programme.title: Meltdown
programme.desc: The team is reunited, but now they must race against the clock to stop Dann from setting off an explosion that will melt the polar ice caps and send the world into a new Ice Age.

programme.title: Hollywood Beginning
programme.desc: Three months after their battle in the arctic, the team is back in L.A. with one major change: theyve been fired as Spy Racers! Most of the team is able to easily readjust to civilian life: Frostee is trying to get his license and Layla is a professional stunt driver in the biggest movie franchise in the world. But Tony cant rest his gut is telling him that Dann is still out there and is plotting to destroy L.A. and hell stop at nothing to prove it.

programme.title: Dann Hunt
programme.desc: Tony was right Dann is back and shes been spotted all around Los Angeles! The Spy Racers get back together on an unofficial mission to bring her down! Meanwhile, Ms. Nowhere, Palindrome and Roscoe run their out bounty hunter operation.

programme.title: Captain Underpants and the Tenuous Takedown of the Tyrannical Teachertrons
programme.desc: In the season opener, George and Harold have returned to school due to a technicality, but the school has been taken over by Melvin and a cyborg Melvin from the future! Their goal is to make the school extremely difficult by replacing all the teachers with Teachertron robots. Suffering under the new regime and without Mr. KruppCaptain Underpants on hand to help, the boys hypnotize gym teacher Mr. Meaner and turn him into Sergeant Boxers to fight back.

programme.title: Captain Underpants and the Frantic Fury of the Fearsome Furculees
programme.desc: Tired of the Melvins ruling the school, the boys realize that they need Mr. Krupp to make the school at least bearable. Unfortunately, Krupp has run off to Ecuador to look for a fabled fountain. So the boys form the M.I.S.F.A.R.T.S. - Mega Incredible Search Force Adventure Rescue Team Squad - to travel to Ecuador and bring Krupp back, whether he wants it or not.

programme.title: Captain Underpants and the Harmful Horrors of the Harrowing Hiveschool
programme.desc: After injecting all the teachers with bee DNA, the Melvins run the new hivemind of the school. But Ms. Ribble is accidently injected with too much Bee- NA and becomes the queen bee, overpowering the Melvins control. George, Harold and the recently re-hired Vice Principal Krupp must work with the Melvins and stop her from turning everyone into her Zombees.

programme.title: Alphabout
programme.desc: Trained by her parents, Eep competes in Alphafight-- a tournament where the animal kingdom fights to determine the dominant species. But when Eep learns that a human winning could upset the balance of nature, she must choose between winning to make her parents proud, and losing to protect the other animals.

programme.title: Bad Luck Moon Rising
programme.desc: Phil and Guy try to disprove the Croods belief that leaving offerings to the fire moon will prevent bad luck. But when their efforts seem to cause a series of mishaps, theyll have to retrieve the horn of a dangerous ramaconda to turntheir luck around.

programme.title: Beardfoot
programme.desc: Upset that he cant grow a beard, Grug resorts to some unorthodox hair growth methods. But when Phils experimental hair formula makes fur grow all over Grugs body, he flees to the woods to avoid the other farm residents attempts to shave him.

programme.title: The Great Medieval London Fire 1135
programme.desc: Boss Baby and Tina reject the 5er system that says the cuter you are, the more love you deserve. Teaming up with the Uncuddleables, the team tries to take down the system from within, forming a resistance of the eight department heads of Baby Corp in the hopes of changing the way we look at Baby Love forever.

programme.title: Untitled Templeton Project
programme.desc: Fired from Baby Corp and trying to build their own business, Boss Baby and Tina waste all their startup funds immediately, requiring a loan from Banker Baby Benny. In order to receive their seed money and get their company rolling, they have to rebuild the towns faith in a baby who made everyone miss a huge sporting even and they have to do it on a very limited budget

programme.title: Puppy Love
programme.desc: Unable to land baby clients, Boss and Tina take in a naughty little puppy as a side hustle, trying to earn a little extra scrap. But once they discover the dogs in the neighborhood are stealing for a puppy trainer named Becker, the mission gets much bigger, and our team is forced to earn a little Puppy Love for once.

programme.title: Meltdown
programme.desc: The team is reunited, but now they must race against the clock to stop Dann from setting off an explosion that will melt the polar ice caps and send the world into a new Ice Age.

programme.desc: 一城一味八闽有鲜味，美食年番一城一味系列本季八闽有鲜味以福州为核心，以鲜味为指引，辐射周围的泉州漳州莆田宁德平潭等极具美食人文自然特色，且用户好奇度高的城市，寻觅最能代表当地特色的鲜味美食，突出食材鲜做法鲜味道鲜佐料鲜的八闽鲜味也通过一个个不同的美食与美食背后的故事，让观众感受到这些城市的温度与魅力

programme.title: 申医生Doctor Shin
programme.desc: 剧集讲述外科医生，爱上因事故而陷入脑昏迷的知名女星，为拯救她而进行了禁忌的脑部置换手术，之后的故事交织着爱情与欲望禁忌与牺牲Genius neurosurgeon Shin Ju-shin is head over heels in love with top actress Momo. When Momo falls into a coma following a tragic accident, Ju-shin faces the prospect of losing her. Driven by desperation, he crosses ethical lines and performs a forbidden brain change or soul-transfer surgery. Momo eventually wakes up, but she is inhabited by a different consciousness, triggering tragic and unforeseen consequences.

programme.desc: 一场银行爆炸案打破华澳市的宁静，警官丁奇站在惨烈的爆炸现场却异常平静因为他知晓这并非最终结局而是循环日，世界会随机进入连续五次的循环，零点零分回溯前一天，普通人无感，唯有他靠时间循环感知力屡破奇案新循环一次次开启，离奇之处相继显现：生物集团多名高管接连死亡，伴随着神秘的乌贼杀人警告，意外频发看似机械重复的日常下，阴谋渐显丁奇更发现，自己并非唯一掌控时间密钥的人当多名时间循环感知者搅动时空，第五个循环日的最终对决，将为你揭开所有谜团In a specific time and space, detective Ding Qi accidentally discovered that he had the ability to reverse time and repeat the cycle five times on the same day from time to time. programme.title: 真料理两锅论第二季Lets Guo S2
programme.desc: 料理实境节目真料理两锅论由邰智源罗时丰黄镫辉KID林柏升温妮丘涵共同主持节目中主持人们将分为两组PK对决，亲自出马找寻稀有食材超强主厨及传奇秘方与菜单，献上最美味的完美料理Cooking reality show Lets Guo is hosted by Taiwanese artistes Tai Chih-yuan, Lo Shih-feng, Huang Chien-hui, KID Lin Po-sheng, Winnie, and Chiu Han. In the show, the hosts are divided into two teams for competition, venturing out to seek for rare ingredients, exceptional chefs, and legendary recipes and menus, presenting the most delicious and perfect dishes.

programme.title: 江湖菜馆第五季 无肉不欢KungFu Licious S5 Feast of Meat
programme.desc: 江湖菜馆第五季 无肉不欢以肉为主题设立六个单元，探访新疆湖南山东北京绍兴成都襄阳长沙重庆等18座城市，深入挖掘肉食江湖和市井烟火气Food docu KungFu Licious returns with a fifth season to venture into the streets and alleys of 18 different cities, exploring meat-loving hotspots this time round and presenting the pleasures of meat through a huge variety of local meat delicacies.

programme.title: 川味 5 一宴千年Legendary Taste of Sichuan S5
programme.desc: 以四季节气与传统节日为线索，节目深入探寻四川巴蜀特色文化宴席，展现宴所承载的历史文化民俗风情与非遗传承，呈现巴蜀独特而深厚的文化与美食魅力Guided by the four seasons and traditional festivals, the series explores Sichuan bashus distinctive banquet culture, where every feast reflects history, folk traditions, and intangible heritage. Through seasonal cuisine, local flavours, customs, and landscapes, it celebrates the regions rich culinary legacy.

programme.title: 天赐的声音第7季The Treasured Voice S7

programme.desc: A drama anthology that touches on the various issues that Filipinos deal with regularly.

programme.title: Reel Life Weekend My Teacher
programme.desc: A comedy-drama about a high-school teacher who returns to her hometown and finds an unexpected source of wisdom and inspiration in her 70-year-old student.

programme.title: Mommy Dearest
programme.desc: Two mothers, Emma and Olive, share love for sickly child Mookie. Birth mother Olive cares for her health, while maid Emma becomes her close friend - until Olive intervenes in their growing bond.

programme.title: I Bilib
programme.desc: The show features scientific experiments and explores different scientific facts and theories surrounding everyday events presented in magical manner. The show also features some cosplay pictures by different cosplayers.

programme.title: Dami Mong Alam, Kuya Kim!

programme.title: Born To Be Wild
programme.desc: A travel and wildlife documentary series that brings viewers up close with nature, wildlife, and environmental conservation issues across the Philippines and beyond.

programme.title: Daig Kayo ng Lola Ko
programme.desc: A fantasy-anthology series where Lola Goreng and her grandchildren share magical stories that teach values and life lessons to children and families.

programme.title: The Final Pitch Dubai
programme.desc: Sixteen ambitious startup founders compete head-to-head in Dubai to secure multi-million dollar investments, mentorship, and strategic partnerships from the Middle Easts top venture capitalists and business tycoons.

programme.title: Heart World
programme.desc: A reality-lifestyle series that follows Heart Evangelista as she opens up about her personal life, relationships, family, fashion career, and experiences around the world.

programme.title: Biyahe ni Drew

programme.title: 听！台湾在唱歌 2Listen! Taiwan Sings 2
programme.desc: 第二季的节目由旺福乐团主唱姚小民首次担纲主持，背着吉他走访台湾各地，与歌手来宾一同探索在地文化与音乐故事他以音乐人的独特视角重新诠释经典歌曲，透过真诚而温暖的旅程，带领观众感受台湾的人文风情与土地魅力新世代的金奖歌手，将走唱更多老歌及在地故事Hosted by Wonfus frontman Yao Xiao Min, this season travels across Taiwan with award-winning guest artistes, reimagining classic songs and uncovering local stories through music. A heartfelt journey celebrating Taiwans people and heritage.

programme.title: 型男大主厨Stylish Man
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖每一期将有不同的主题：大明星來下廚由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；五分钟出好菜由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的

programme.title: 追分成功Define Your Own Success
programme.desc: 这是一部现代家庭伦理剧，看同住一屋簷下的单身房客，北漂追求梦想，在收获爱情友情的同时，也面临得到与失去他们向往完美爱情渴望幸福婚姻追求事业高升，不停向前追分，在这一路跌撞相互陪伴的欢笑与泪水中，定义属于自己的成功！This drama series follows a group of single tenants under the same roof who travelled north to pursue their dreams, love and friendship. They yearn for perfect love, long for a happy marriage, and a good career advancement. Stumbling along the way with tears and laughter, they each define success by their own standards.

programme.desc: 这是一部现代家庭伦理剧，看同住一屋簷下的单身房客，北漂追求梦想，在收获爱情友情的同时，也面临得到与失去他们向往完美爱情渴望幸福婚姻追求事业高升，不停向前追分，在这一路跌撞相互陪伴的欢笑与泪水中，定义属于自己的成功！This drama series follows a group of single tenants under the same roof who travelled north to pursue their dreams, love and friendship. They yearn for perfect love, long for a happy marriage, and a good career advancement. Stumbling along the way with tears and laughter, they each define success by their own standards.

programme.title: 型男大主厨Stylish Man
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖每一期将有不同的主题：大明星來下廚由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；五分钟出好菜由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的

programme.title: 超级夜总会Super Nightclub

programme.title: 无忧渡The Demon Hunters Romance
programme.desc: 无忧渡讲述了一个有着神秘背景的猎魔人宣夜和一个聪明可爱的女孩半夏，一起保护自己家园的奇幻故事自从半夏与宣夜认识之后，两人在人妖共存的世界共历奇情悬案，共同调查着一件件诡异的案件，两个人的感情也越来越好，可是因为宣夜身上的秘密，两个人却一次又一次的远离，最终发现半夏是揭开他身上秘密的钥匙

programme.title: 夜色正浓The Glamorous Night
programme.desc: 该剧根据右耳的原著小说Sales夫妇改编，讲述了一群在洋酒行业相关工作的年轻人，行业白领们，为了业绩与生活努力奋斗拼搏，一路上被人性与现实考验，最终从底层的促销员成为行业风云人物的成长故事Adapted from You Ers novel Sales Couple, the series tells the story of a group of young professionals working in the imported liquor industry as white-collar workers strive to succeed in both their careers and personal lives.

programme.title: 轧戏Love Between Lines
programme.desc: 肖稚宇与胡羞因一场民国主题剧本杀结缘漫雪纷飞谍影交错的剧本世界里，两人碰撞出宿命火花；现实世界的意外重逢，却揭开彼此身份谜题当剧本幻境与现实生活悄然重叠，二人穿梭于戏中戏的错位时空，最终在跨越维度的羁绊中实现双向成长，完成对爱情与自我的进阶蜕变The story follows Xiao Zhiyu and Hu Xiu meet during a Republican-era themed role-playing game, where espionage and fate intertwine. Their unexpected real-world reunion unveils hidden identities, blurring the lines between fiction and reality. As they navigate a dislocated space-time, they grow together, transforming through love and self-discovery.

programme.title: 我不是大师The Prophet
programme.desc: 上官诚明全家惨遭天相派设局灭门，他化名潜伏，以牙还牙，以眼还眼，联手身陷泥淖却势要逆天改命的江飞燕，用连环骗局反噬仇敌，一路揭露骗术黑幕，最终瓦解天相派，解救受控者，惩恶扬善终彰善念After his family is slaughtered by a powerful cult, Shangguan Chengming returns under a false identity to seek revenge. Partnering with the defiant Jiang Feiyan, he turns deception against deception, exposing dark conspiracies, toppling the sect, and delivering long-overdue justice.

programme.title: Wild Sky Season 1
programme.desc: Scan the Australian skies, which regularly deliver some of the worlds most volatile weather. Await cooling monsoon rains, watch lightning ignite vast wildfires, and marvel at the ingenious adaptations that help wildlife deal with these extremes.

programme.title: Wild Sky Season 1
programme.desc: Experience the powerful, colourful phenomena that swirl across the heavens in North America. Watch polar bears search for food under the aurora borealis, map the frigid path of a polar vortex, and elude violent tornadoes with a prairie dog family.

programme.title: Wild Sky Season 1
programme.desc: Observe the eternal search for water that defines the lives of Africas wild animals. Witness the biggest marine feeding frenzy on Earth, see how cobras stock up on solar power, and join wildebeest herds and elephant clans on their epic migrations.

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon Season 1
programme.desc: Explore how lunar phases set the rhythm for an endless contest between predator and prey. Soar by moonlight with colugos, gorge on a shellfish feast with macaques, and watch a prowling pride of lions try to turn a baby elephant into dinner.

programme.title: Alien Abyss Season 1
programme.desc: Get acquainted with an array of ocean oddballs and learn how billions of years worth of changes, from ice ages to asteroid strikes, have shaped their looks and skills. Meet blind worms who fish, walking sharks, tree-climbing crabs, and much more.

programme.title: Alien Abyss Season 1
programme.desc: Feel the love in the strange-but-heartwarming partnerships between some of Earths oddest creatures. Dive deep to see strange animals, from snapping shrimp to wolf eels, offer a hand to their fellow ocean-going weirdos to ensure mutual survival.

programme.title: Alien Abyss Season 1
programme.desc: Channel your inner sci-fi fan and explore the bizarre mating rituals of the oceans most peculiar creatures. Learn how bloody battles for mates, gender bending and supersize litters of babies just might secure a next generation for these animals.

programme.title: Animal Senses Season 1
programme.desc: The sense of touch is useful to feel physical forces such as bites, changes in temperature and texture. Some animals have become extra sensitive to very faint vibrations, which gives them a lot of information about their environment.

programme.title: Africas Hidden Kingdoms Season 1
programme.desc: This documentary looks at the wildlife of The Drakensberg Mountain range. We take a look at how creatures survive in the hostile landscape, from the highest peaks to the rolling grasslands below.

programme.title: Island of the Monsoon Season 1
programme.desc: The shadowy forests of Yala National Park are the perfect hideout for secretive leopards. Its time for one young female, Asha, to strike out alone. Join her as she fights for her own territory, finds a mate, and becomes a mother.

programme.title: Island of the Monsoon Season 1
programme.desc: Every year, the biggest elephant congregation in Asia occurs in Minneriya National Park. Here in this sacred place, baby Loka is born. Watch as he learns to suckle, swim and handle his trunk among the mle of giants that make up his family.

programme.title: Island of the Monsoon Season 1
programme.desc: Sri Lankas lowlands are dotted with thousands of seemingly peaceful lakes, but dont be fooled, this is the realm of the mugger crocodile. Muggers are hunters from day one. Watch as these supreme predators compete with each other in the fierce heat.

programme.title: Island of the Monsoon Season 1
programme.desc: A manmade lake in Minneriya National Park supports the largest concentration of elephants in Asia. Follow a young male who has reached a turning point toward adulthood. In the rainforest, jungles teem with a variety of bizarre species of insects.

programme.title: Island of the Monsoon Season 1
programme.desc: Monsoon storms sweep over the tropical island of Sri Lanka, and water carried in with swirling mists hits the mountainous heartland, beginning a journey through the many changing faces of the islands forests.

programme.title: Island of the Monsoon Season 1
programme.desc: Yala National Park is an avian Eden, home to 215 species of bird. This paradise offers many possibilities for parents who can weather the ever-changing climate. Every species must either raise their offspring here or find a new home before the dry season ends and the monsoon storms begin.

programme.title: Cub Camp Season 1
programme.desc: Spy on the summer cubs as they learn to climb trees and forage for food in preparation for their release into the wild. Get surprised by a set of new arrivals, observe the annual pre-hibernation eating binge, and enjoy a bear-friendly Thanksgiving.

programme.title: Cub Camp Season 1
programme.desc: Prepare for the summer cubs release with Roger, then meet Ace and Little Blueberry, two newbies with serious health issues who will have to stay over the winter with the Z cubs. Later, celebrate as six healthy, happy bears embark on their new life.

programme.title: Supersenses Season 1
programme.desc: Vision its how ninety-five percent of animals interpret the world. Every species on Earth is a chapter in the fascinating story of sight. This episode follows that story from blurry beginnigs to mind-blowing hexnocular vision.

programme.title: Supersenses Season 1
programme.desc: See the animals that push the limits of physics, chemistry and engineering to pull off feats that humans can only dream of, and find out how evolution granted them with such amazing abilities. Sometimes it takes a super-power just to survive.

programme.title: Supersenses Season 1
programme.desc: Dive into a dazzling world beyond human perception, where animals use their super senses to detect light we cant see, sound we cant hear and even stranger forces we cant begin to detect.

programme.title: Irelands Wild Islands Season 1

programme.title: Europes Wild Kingdom Season 1

programme.title: Europes Wild Kingdom Season 1

Kapal terbang yang mereka naiki terlanggar seekor burung helang dan mengakibatkan pesawat itu bergegar. Dalam keadaan kelam kabut itu, seorang demi seorang penerjun melompat keluar dan mendarat di sebuah kawasan hutan. Di sana, mereka diganggu pelbagai peristiwa dan menganggap tempat itu berpuaka. Namun, Kapten Hanafi mengesyaki semua peristiwa itu adalah berpunca daripada perbuatan manusia.

programme.title: Perjanjian Syaitan
programme.desc: Tambun membunuh Tok Kadim, penghulu di sebuah kampung dan kemudiannya mengatakan bahawa Tok Kadim mati satu kemalangan. Selepas kejadian itu, Tambun dilantik menjadi ketua kampung yang baharu. Pada masa yang sama, Ribut, adik kepada Tambun yang berwajah hodoh ingin membalas dendam kepada Ujang kerana menolak cintanya dan memilih Seri sebagai teman. Ribut bersahabat dengan syaitan yang berjanji untuk menjadikannya seorang perempuan cantik. Sejak itulah Ribut berusaha untuk membalas dendam sehingga berlaku beberapa siri kematian yang penuh misteri.

programme.title: Dendam Dari Pusara
programme.desc: Dolah, seorang buruh kasar yang cacat kaki sejak kecil mempunyai ilmu luar biasa yang diperolehinya dengan memotong dagu si mati dijadikan minyak tetapi perlu mematuhi syarat ketat dengan memulangkan barang-barang yang diperolehi dalam tempoh seribu hari. . Dolah melakukan kerja ngeri ini dengan bantuan dua orang kawannya, tetapi pada suatu masa dia telah gagal memenuhi syarat tersebut dan bermacam kejadian telah berlaku selepas itu.

programme.title: Sate

Kadir ingin menyertai Anugerah Saintis untuk memenangi hadiah utama dan sekaligus menyenangkan hidup Milah. Pelbagai rintangan terpaksa dia lalui untuk mencipta mesin miliknya dan akhirnya Kadir berjaya menyiapkan mesin tersebut dan menyertai pertandingan itu.

programme.title: Putera

Ayahanda Putera Hussein memberi tempoh selama 30 hari kepadanya untuk mencari bakal isteri. Putera Hussein menyamar sebagai rakyat biasa dan bertemu dengan seorang gadis bernama Noraini. Mereka berdua jatuh cinta namun percintaan itu mendapat halangan keluarga Noraini.

Dewi, seorang gadis buta yang memboleh membaca minda memutuskan untuk membantu Azri berhubung dengan Seri. Lama kelamaan, perasaan cinta mula muncul dan Azri harus membuat pilihan yang sukar.

programme.title: Only Fools Fall in Love
programme.desc: Zhao Fu Lau Ching-wan is the head of the Zhao family. Although wealthy, powerful, and exceptionally intelligent, his sharp-tongued and competitive nature prevents him from finding happiness. The second-in-command, Zhao Ji Dayo Wong, has long harbored resentment towards Fu, compounded by his debts from gambling, drinking, and prostitution. He persuades Wang Di Ng Sin-lin, a street performer, to enter into a sham marriage with Fu to swindle a dowry. Di and her father Yuen Wah, wanting to settle down, agree. Before the wedding ceremony, Fu tries to steal fireworks, but Ji changes tactics, causing Fu to fall from a height in the chaos, leaving him mentally impaired. Realizing the gravity of the situation, Di and her father flee, changing their surnames and starting a new life. Ji considers killing Fu, but Fu escapes. Fate brings Fu and Di together again. At a market, Di sees Fu as a beggar, living a life of hardship, and driven by guilt and compassion, takes him in. As they spent more time together, feelings blossomed between them. The younger brother found it hard to believe he was moved by the sincerity of a simpleton, while Fu experienced unprecedented joy in love. On a beautiful, sunny day, Ji sent men to disrupt Fu and the younger brothers world, also affecting their neighbors. Fu and the younger brother decided they had to take advantage of their fair and impartial great-uncles Qiao Hong birthday banquet to return to the Zhao family, expose Jis evil deeds, and seek justice. Thus, a simpleton formally declared war on a cunning and treacherous man

programme.desc: As the saying goes, Todays news is tomorrows history. With so much news every day, its hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. programme.desc: After leaving a successful but unfulfilling career, Han-Shiao reopens her familys beloved bistro to rebuild her life and reconnect with her loved ones. As old romances return, hidden family secrets emerge, and three generations of women face love, sacrifice, forgiveness, and new beginnings.

programme.title: Trending Topic
programme.desc: Chen Miao, an online media editor-in-chief, wrote a popular article which has become a trending topic. This however, led indirectly to a girls suicide. After receiving a help request, she realises that there is more to the story than meets the eye. As public opinion sways on the case, a war to speak up for the weak has begun!

programme.title: I Did It My Way
programme.desc: As the secretive, complex world of online drug trafficking increasingly targets Hong Kong, the police launches a risky and top-secret sting operation to bring down one of the most notorious drug lords in Asia.

programme.title: Old Fox
programme.desc: In 1989, young Liao Jie and his father save for a home, unaware of rising property prices. Frustrated by poverty, he learns from their landlord Old Fox who teaches him survival in society. Liao Jie ends up hurting Old Fox with what he has learnt, but his empathy prevents him from becoming like Old Fox.

programme.title: Atonement
programme.desc: Single father Ah Long lives a humble life with his beloved daughter, believing kindness will always be rewarded. However, when she is abducted during a trip to Thailand, his faith shatters. Desperate to find her, he marries a local Chinese woman to remain in the country and hunt down a human trafficking ring, becoming a blood-soaked avenger.

programme.title: Back Home
programme.desc: Wing has been able to see ghosts since young. When his mothers suicide attempt forces him to return to Hong Kong and the home he ran away from, he discovers that the horrific visions that once haunted him have become worse. Caught between the living and the dead, Wing must bring the truth to light to be free.

programme.title: Dust To Dust
programme.desc: Back in 1995, the Police successfully arrested five armed bank robbers while the two masterminds got tipped off and made a clean escape. Decades later, retired cop Wang Shou Yue is drawn back to the unsolved case when he sees a blurred figure in a news clip. A battle between good and evil has just begun!

programme.title: Keep Rolling
programme.desc: Directorial debut of Man Lim Chung, who spent 3 years filming this documentary about the life and filmmaking philosophy of Ann Hui, one of Hong Kongs greatest filmmakers. It traces Huis life story and her 40-year careers ups and downs using film footages, candid conversations with Hui, and interviews with her collaborators, family and friends.

programme.title: Wise Guys Never Die
programme.desc: Nick meets Teddy, a con artiste, when he is sent to prison for embezzlement, and Teddy teaches him all the gambling tricks. After their release, they team up with Teddys lover Lora, to take revenge on Dragon, who framed Teddy for his sentence. Nick though is seduced by Lora and they end up in an affair. Will Nick finally join Teddy in his revenge?

programme.title: Far Far Away
programme.desc: A 28-year-old IT geek has only been in love once. Surprisingly, he ends up getting romantically involved with five different women this year and the one thing they have in common is that they all live in far flung areas of Hong Kong. After taking five intensive relationship courses within these 365 days, will he find the-one?

programme.title: Confinement
programme.desc: Si Ling, a pregnant painter, moves into her dream home after winning an award and hires a confinement nanny. As she begins her one-month confinement after giving birth to her daughter, inexplicable incidents start happening in the house, threatening both her and her baby

programme.title: One More Chance
programme.desc: A gambling-addicted Fai is entrusted by his ex-girlfriend to care for their autistic son. What begins as a chaotic father-son relationship gradually becomes a journey of mutual redemption, helping him rediscover himself. When he discovers his sons talent for running, Fai resolves to leave the past behind and support his son in pursuing his dreams.

programme.title: Caught In Time
programme.desc: Based on true events, Detective Zhong Cheng leads a task force in pursuit of Eagle, a criminal gang led by Zhang Sun. Highly methodical and disciplined, the gang manages to avoid capture after each heist. A decade later, the need to stop Eagle is more urgent than ever when Zhong Cheng realizes that his time is almost up to solve the case.

programme.title: Limbo
programme.desc: Hong Kong is rocked by a series of brutal murders committed by a serial killer. Veteran detective Cham and rookie cop Will are assigned to the case. During the investigation, they encounter Wang Tao, who accidentally killed Chams wife. Seeking redemption, Wang assists them in tracking down the killer, but her involvement puts her in grave danger.

programme.title: Measure in Love
programme.desc: A massive earthquake splits the world into two regions where time flows at different speeds. During a medical relief mission, student An Qing meets Shu Zai, and an extraordinary bond begins. Yet with every reunion, he ages rapidly while she remains unchanged, forcing them to confront a love challenged by time, distance, and fate.

programme.title: Silent Code
programme.desc: Reporter Lan is tasked to research news from the internet, and stumbles across a popular BBS forum, Dream Board. The forum founder Xiang, creates space for netizens to share dreams and ideas, but ends up being the subject of a heated debate due to a leaked video. As Lan digs for the truth, she finds that things more complicated than they seem...

programme.title: Back to the Past
programme.desc: After helping Ying Zheng unite China, Hong Siu Lung lives in seclusion for 20 years. However, peace is shattered when a group of time travellers returns with modern weapons to seize the Qin throne. Forced to reunite after decades apart, Hong Siu Lung and Ying Zheng must fight to defend the Qin dynasty and protect the fate of history itself.

programme.title: Possession Street
programme.desc: When seven vengeful spirits turn the tenants of an abandoned mall into zombies, a video store owner, his daughter and a feng shui master must fight for survival. As the undead multiply and the evil spirits grow stronger, they race to stop the haunting before the entire mall descends into a living hell.

programme.title: Enchanting Shadow
programme.desc: A young scholar Ning spends the night in a creepy temple that is said to be haunted. He does not believe in the rumours, but soon meets a beautiful female ghost Nie. Nie is forced to stay in the temple to seduce young men for a powerful demon to feast on. Knowing Nie to be a kind ghost, Ning decides to help her escape from the demons clutches.

programme.title: The Lady Professional
programme.desc: Lily Ho is perfectly cast as a gun-for-hire who always gets her man - in more ways than one! The cast and crew shot on location in Japanese scenic spots such as Mount Fuji and there are plenty of over-the-top thrills, as Lily even masquerades as a nun.

programme.title: Rear Entrance
programme.desc: Mrs Xu is childless and watches a lonely little girl playing at the rear entrance from afar every day. She warmly nurtures the girl and even adopts her from her uncaring parent. The girl brings happiness to the Xus until her long lost mother appears one day and to make her happy, Mrs Xu reluctantly lets the girl reunite with her mother.

programme.title: Executioners From Shaolin
programme.desc: The White-Browed Priest supports the brutal Qing government, burning down Shaolin Temple and hunting its disciples. Shaolins Hung falls in love with Fang while escaping the hunt and the couple have a son before Hung is killed by the Priest. To avenge his father, Hungs son creates a new form of martial art combining his parents kung fu styles.

programme.title: The Voyage of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung continues his incognito voyage to southern China. Accompanied by the minister and the imperial scholar, they have many amusing encounters in Yangzhou.

programme.title: The Condemned
programme.desc: Feng, a homeless man, is wrongly accused of robbery and subsequently arrested and imprisoned. The actual bandit bribes fellow inmate Yang, a pickpocket, to kill Feng. Aware of Fengs innocence, Yang resolves to help him escape from prison. However, their escape attempt goes awry, and both find themselves facing the grim reality of death row.

programme.title: Crocodile River
programme.desc: This story has a Romeo and Juliet flavour. Two families who hate each other live across the opposite sides of a river filled with crocodiles and do not bother to have a bridge built. Their respective children meet in university and fall in love, but have to find ways to be together and resolve the hatred between their families.

programme.title: Portrait In Crystal
programme.desc: Tragic deaths in the underworld cause leader Yama Teng Wei-hao to suspect a portrait in crystal with mysterious powers. He sends Hen Pan Chen Hung and Pai Pan Hung Hsin-nan to interrogate its creator, martial artist Lung Fei Pai Piao...

programme.title: Woman Of The Night
programme.desc: The movie offers three stories of love and obsession. In the first tale, a young student with a voyeuristic habit spies on two of his female roommates. The second story follows an office manager who develops an infatuation for his secretary. The last story is a complex family drama about a debilitated father who forces his family to leave him.

programme.title: Killer Darts
programme.desc: A group of bandits raided the village where dart master Liu lives and killed his wife. While hunting them down, Lius disciple kills a farmer and his wife when she refuses his advances, leading Liu to adopt their orphaned daughter and raises her with his son. Years later, the daughter meets a man with the bandits and is tricked to go against Liu.

programme.title: Police Force
programme.desc: A man joins the Hong Kong police force to track down a murderer who has killed his friend in a robbery. While he struggles to reconcile his law defending police duty with his desire for vengeance, he also has a new-found respect for the law.

programme.title: Lets Fall In Love
programme.desc: Da Yung, the son of a rich entrepreneur, meets Lian Lian, the niece of a kindergarten principal by chance. They fall into a misunderstanding on the first meeting, causing Da Yung to lose his wallet. Further misunderstanding occurs when he tries to get her to act as his fianc so as to drive away two women whom he does not like

programme.title: Clan Feuds
programme.desc: Tie Zhong Tang, adopted son of Da Chi Men leader Yun Yi, is hunted by rival Situ Xiao, who seeks the clans hidden treasure. To uncover its secrets, Tie journeys to Changchun Island to find the legendary Ri Hou. Instead, he finds Ri Hou dead and discovers the clans founder, Ye Di Tie Yi, is his real father.

programme.title: Two Con Men
programme.desc: Two Con Men is a wonderfully twisted, pseudo-romantic comedy in the vein of Robin Hood meets The Sting. Starring Liang Tien as Clever Chan and Chang Ying whos done over 400 films as Tricky Ching, its the age-old competition between a rookie con artist versus the ultimate, experienced flimflam man. Its a game Chen cannot afford to lose, because peoples lives - including his own, hang in the balance of good versus evil.

programme.title: Rolls, Rolls, I Love You
programme.desc: Three young men offend a billionaire and are drawn into a high stakes bet. If they win, they get to keep the billionaires Rolls Royce. Otherwise, they will need to pay the rich man fifty thousand dollars! Will the underdogs win the bet?

programme.title: Return Of The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This sequel makes for more bittersweet laughs and heart-wrenching misfortune, as Ah Niu gets out of the jail to find his true love becoming the wife of an abusive husband, and his uncle further exploits his naive nature.

programme.title: Iron Bodyguard
programme.desc: Wang Wu, the head of a security firm Iron Bodyguard, meets a scholar who is a member of the Reformists, a group of scholars pressing for social reform in China at the end of the Qing dynasty. The Emperor actually supports such reforms but not the Empress Dowager. She orders the Reformists to be arrested and Wang Wu gets drawn into the politics.

programme.title: We Love Millionaires
programme.desc: In this romantic comedy, three beautiful Hong Kong salesgirls travel to Osaka in Japan to pursue their dreams of marrying a rich man. They masquerade as high society debutantes and make their way to a posh resort to meet and woo millionaires or fake ones!.

programme.title: The Kid With The Golden Arm
programme.desc: The government hires Yang to escort a cargo of gold to a famine stricken area. The vicious Chi Sha gang, with one of their best fighters, Golden Arm, announce their intention to hijack it by killing one of Yangs employees. As Yang gathers his own team of reputable fighters to protect his cargo, are they strong enough to hold off Golden Arm?

人生調色盤
programme.desc: 歌仔戲小生陳亞蘭小姐首次獨挑大梁，主持深度人物訪談節目人生調色盤 人生問題是一門大學問，悲歡離合生老病死是每個人會經歷的過程，特別是隨著社會發展而衍生出新的問題，例如職場與網路的霸凌憂鬱症親人失智長照等，都是過去所罕見的 節目透過嘉賓的經驗分享，輔以專家學者從旁論述分析，掌握選擇的思考過程，釐清正確的觀念，藉以產生改變自己的能量主持人陳亞蘭也發揮歌仔戲隱惡揚善的精神，將忠孝節義的處世準則，於節目中傳播出去 為了推廣台語之美，特別規劃亞蘭話俗語單元，每集介紹一句台灣俚俗語，簡單直白卻字字珠璣，不僅學習到老祖宗的智慧，也貼近自己的人生

programme.desc: 此音只應天上有，人間哪得幾回聞梵唄就是清淨之意，除了耳根享受之外，最主要的仍在心靈的清淨，歌詠時還伴以管弦或敲擊樂器，普及佛教教義

programme.title: 人生調色盤
programme.desc: 歌仔戲小生陳亞蘭小姐首次獨挑大梁，主持深度人物訪談節目人生調色盤 人生問題是一門大學問，悲歡離合生老病死是每個人會經歷的過程，特別是隨著社會發展而衍生出新的問題，例如職場與網路的霸凌憂鬱症親人失智長照等，都是過去所罕見的 節目透過嘉賓的經驗分享，輔以專家學者從旁論述分析，掌握選擇的思考過程，釐清正確的觀念，藉以產生改變自己的能量主持人陳亞蘭也發揮歌仔戲隱惡揚善的精神，將忠孝節義的處世準則，於節目中傳播出去 為了推廣台語之美，特別規劃亞蘭話俗語單元，每集介紹一句台灣俚俗語，簡單直白卻字字珠璣，不僅學習到老祖宗的智慧，也貼近自己的人生

programme.title: 映照人生第524集
programme.desc: 印尼，是個超過兩億人口的東南亞大國，貧富差距極大，且語言文化種族差異均大由印尼大愛臺製作的映照人生，報導當地各面向的社會議題，從2010年起逐年獲獎，被譽為是印尼正面紀錄片的先驅之一 製作團隊都是由印尼的工作同仁，以在地觀點，對印尼社會做深度觀察，發現問題，報導當事人如何解決或面對，製作出一系列感人且啟發人心的故事，傳達以人道為關懷精神的節目內容 本節目記錄著印尼底層的人們，每個勇敢迎向苦難與希望的故事；也帶領觀眾看見，這個世界的黑暗角落，因為人性的光輝，所映照出的光明

programme.title: 婆羅浮屠第2集

programme.title: 關於我撞鬼的故事第1集

programme.title: 我們的島第1379集
programme.desc: 一個一小時的節目，能帶給觀眾什麼，能影響什麼？如果把它只當成一個節目，會感覺短短一小時很短暫，如果把它當成一條出路，會發現力量也可以很強大，一直以來，我們節目的理念就是尋求一種改變的可能性，只要有一個人因為看過報導而改變了，反省也好，感動也好，警惕也好，行動也好，就有可能形塑一種新的環境公民力量，也有可能讓錯誤的政策不再繼續1998年11月1日我們的島節目正式播出，當年台灣的環境還處於大肆開發的年代，在經濟掛帥的氛圍中，我們的島為環境發出另一種聲音，至今我們的島仍是台灣媒體中，唯一以環境為報導主題的新聞性節目，也是公共電視開播以來歷史最久的新聞性節目，這十五年我們的島製作

programme.title: 生活科技大解密第14季:第3集

programme.title: 貓咪101第3季:第2集
programme.desc: 土耳其梵貓是自然貓種，不是由愛貓人育種而成牠們很強壯，也是少數喜歡游泳的貓種雪鞋貓是暹羅貓的分枝，育種人發現一窩小貓裡其中一隻有白色腳掌，新貓種於焉誕生沙特爾貓是來自法國的古老品種，從古至今都廣受法國名人喜愛孟加拉貓是野貓和家貓的稀有混種，以斑紋著稱家貓是最多美國人養的貓，你可以稱之為室內混種貓峇里貓被認為是絕頂聰明的貓種，牠們是長毛版的暹羅貓，而牠們和短毛貓一樣愛叫，需要你時時關注

programme.title: 貓咪101第3季:第3集
programme.desc: 東奇尼貓是愛玩的貓種，毛色視氣候而定尼貝龍貓是唯一只有藍色的長毛貓，也是理毛最困難的貓，是由俄羅斯藍貓和黑色短毛家貓混種而成科拉特貓是敏感的貓種，在泰國牠們被視為婚禮的吉祥禮物賽倫蓋蒂貓愛玩又愛叫，也是最高的純種貓，能跳高達7呎悠閒的襤褸貓喜歡懶洋洋地躺著，牠們很晚才成熟，幼貓期長達4年，所以非常適合有小孩的家庭飼養玩具虎貓很聰明，專門培育出來幫助野生老虎，因為賣貓的利潤會捐出一部分給老虎保育工作，飼主熱愛牠們老虎般的外貌

programme.title: 貓咪101第3季:第4集
programme.desc: 北美洲短毛貓看似美國大山貓，不過是愛玩和親水的貓種，只有這種純種貓有額外的腳趾嬰貓是加拿大無毛貓和短腿曼赤肯貓的混種，儘管皮膚無毛，但牠們並非低過敏原澳洲霧貓是世界上數一數二稀有的品種，在澳洲培育成溫順的家貓，非常適合有小孩子的家庭飼養長毛家貓是美國第二熱門的貓，牠的毛曾用來清理海上漏油獵豹貓一部分是野貓，牠的斑紋和長腿來自亞洲豹貓拿破崙貓是數一數二矮的貓，是近十年來才培育出來的新貓種，而諷刺的是拿破崙卻很怕貓

programme.title: 德州保育戰第5季:第5集
programme.desc: 在傑斯珀郡，異常的天氣帶來大雨，造成民眾的車陷入泥濘中無法動彈，還有樹木倒塌，壓斷電力線在納科多奇斯郡，惡劣的天氣將一隻幼雀鷹從樹上的巢中吹落地面，請來雲梯車將牠放回巢中一對父子試航新買的船，但孩子未穿救生衣，船也未完成移轉登記在拉雷多郡，與墨西哥交界的里約格蘭河上經常有非法捕釣活動，疑似岸邊施工人員違法布置了釣線，甚至還有魚上鉤了在亨特郡，一個人逾期未處理兩張傳票而遭法官開出拘票，並罔顧漁獵巡警的善意提醒，依舊置之不理而遭到通緝在瓜達魯佩郡，今天敦洛普湖上的船隻與水上活動特別多，要加強水上安全檢查與教育

programme.title: 德州保育戰第5季:第6集
programme.desc: 在卡拉罕郡，有人沒有購買魚餌經銷商證卻替別人代購活餌，從中牟利一個汽車駕駛人酒駕自撞柱子後逃逸，三天後自首在帕洛平托郡，負鼠王國湖上今天的船隻特別多，漁獵巡警加強水上安全檢查，一個少年騎著叔叔有違規項目的水上摩托車，但叔叔卻裝作不認識他在傑斯珀郡，兩天前因為無釣魚證被開單的兩個人，今天又遇到臨檢，不過已經買好了釣魚證，令漁獵巡警感到欣慰一位地主報案說拾獲一隻死掉的國鳥，非法獵殺受保護的國鳥判刑極重，漁獵巡警送交聯邦漁獵巡警剖檢後卻認為自然死亡

programme.title: 德州保育戰第5季:第7集
programme.desc: 在泰勒郡，兩個高中生去釣魚，其中一名沒有釣魚證還編謊言，漁獵巡警詢問他們學校前駐警對二的評價，決定只給警告單有位民眾越過柵欄到私人土地釣魚，漁獵巡警接獲檢舉去開警告單時，發現那個人同時有襲擊與家暴的拘票在卡亨郡，一艘捕餌料蝦的船疑似捕獲超量又不願接受檢查，罔顧漁獵巡警警告，將超量漁獲倒入海中，結果受到更重刑度斯密司郡，有民眾通報鄰居養了北美鶉，經查應該原本即為人工飼養，並不違法一位女士受毒品影響精神不正常，正巧經過的漁獵巡警主動報警，請醫護人員過來處理在特勒爾郡，有人檢舉某人持有保育類的木紋響尾蛇，警察驗後那個人是有許可證的一位貨車司機行駛途中胸痛，還有工人因趕著上班超車又超速

programme.title: 動物攻擊力第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 地球上的生態系都是戰區，動物為了生存必須戰鬥，但這些動物對人類而言有多危險，會造成什麼傷害？人類遭到攻擊的機會又有多大？

programme.title: 動物攻擊力第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 在澳洲荒蕪的野地上，動植物經過數百萬年演化，才能在惡劣環境下生存，但外來的澳洲野犬，卻十分適應這個新家，成為頂級掠食者，在最致命動物榜單上排名第十，

programme.title: 動物攻擊力第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 地球的每個生態系都是戰場，動物必須為生存而戰，不過，這些動物牠們對人類來說有多危險呢？牠們能造成怎樣的傷害？發動攻擊的機率又有多高？

programme.title: 動物攻擊力第1季:第4集
programme.desc: 誰是北美洲最致命的動物呢？象鼻海豹在最致命動物名單上排名第十，阿拉斯加成群結隊的北美灰狼憑藉速度與智慧也能致人於死，但是狼襲事件不多，只在第九名

programme.title: 野地贏家第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 大貓是迷人的動物，也是可怕的獵人住在巴西濕地的美洲豹，是兩棲世界的頂級掠食者，稱霸濕地跟雨林；美洲獅統治著智利的高地，靠絕佳的夜視力捕捉高地上的原駝；在納米比沙漠流浪的沙漠獅，不管是狩獵或是養育孩子，靠的都是團隊合作；除了沙漠獅，獰貓也是沙漠獵人，牠靈敏的大耳朵，可以聽到獵物最微弱的聲音；在非洲大草原上還有跑得最快的獵豹；除了牠們，在中國的東北花豹俄羅斯的西伯利亞虎還有西班牙的伊比利大山貓都是瀕危物種，只有靠保育計畫，才能確保這些物種能繼續存活下去

programme.title: 布朗克斯動物園第3季:第10集
programme.desc: 布朗克斯動物園飼養了一對揚子鱷今天是揚子鱷繁殖計畫展開的第一年

programme.title: 野地刺客第1季:第6集

programme.title: 空中巨鯊-尋找巨無霸

programme.title: 管教惡貓第8季:第2集
programme.desc: 貓咪行為專家傑克森蓋勒克西改善過許多問題貓咪，這次他又遇到具有嚴重攻擊傾向和社交障礙的貓咪凱莉，以及因為曾給愛貓安樂死而自責不已的女飼主塔拉塔拉對凱莉的過度保護，是造成牠自我封閉的主要原因另外，愛亂咬亂抓四處破壞的小柯提斯，讓牠的主人在傷透腦筋之餘，決定給牠除爪這一次，傑克森要如何解決人貓之間的難解糾葛呢？凱莉能否走向人群？塔拉又該如何走出過去的創傷？傑克森會用什麼方法阻止柯特給小柯提斯除爪呢？愛貓的你千萬不能錯過本集

programme.title: 超能動物第1季:第1集

programme.title: 超能動物第1季:第2集

programme.title: 美洲大地第1季:第1集

programme.title: 寶貝樹懶第1季:第7集
programme.desc: 在野外，樹懶長長的四肢和超強的抓握力，讓牠們能夠生活在樹梢，所以對靜坐不動的收容所樹懶來說，運動是牠們重要的固定活動

programme.title: 寶貝樹懶第1季:第8集

programme.title: 捕蛇專家第1季:第3集

programme.title: 地球好驚奇第1季:第3集

programme.title: 自然界最天才第1季:第1集

programme.title: 瑪莎與熊第19集
programme.desc: 瑪莎是個充滿朝氣活力四射的小女孩，住在離森林不遠的小木屋裡有天意外地闖進住在森林的熊熊家，開始了充滿歡笑與奇妙的生活從馬戲團退休的熊熊，在森林裡度過了安穩平淡的退休生活，直到遇到了瑪莎，為他的生活增添了許多樂趣，從一開始害怕瑪莎的調皮搗蛋，到逐漸他們成為了最棒的朋友在他們的生活裡充滿著瑪莎的好奇心與熊熊對瑪莎悉心的教導與照顧 瑪莎與熊來自於俄羅斯的3D動畫，故事內容源自於俄羅斯的童話，在俄羅斯受到了大朋友與小朋友的歡迎，故事搬到現代的大螢幕中，更增添了許多冒險故事動畫中所呈現的音樂與內容都有著濃濃的俄羅斯風情，並透過立體3D的呈現方式帶來了視覺與聽覺上的饗宴 瑪莎與熊以輕

programme.desc: 阿澤為了妹妹欣愛的醫藥費，打算出售居住多年的凶宅，卻誤打誤撞成了義勝房屋的菜鳥房仲，這間凶宅專賣店，有著親切的中年店長雄哥舉止像流氓的勇仁零食不離手的饅頭第一天上班，阿澤獨自留在凶宅收尾整理，屋裡傳來小孩的笑聲，突然一支刀騰空而起，飛速地刺向阿澤，這時一隻嬌小的手攔截握住刀，原來是慈安堂的畢婆婆帶著有靈異體質的孫女小墨前來搭救這一群雜牌軍就這麼經營起來，更加入了新人夥伴李靜正當大夥度過一次次賣屋危機時，殊不知，背後有著更大的陰謀等著他們

programme.title: 海角七號
programme.desc: 六十多年前，台灣光復，日本人撤離一名日籍男老師隻身搭上了離開台灣的船隻，也離開了他在台灣的戀人：友子無法當面說出對友子的感情，因此，他把懷念與愛戀化成字句，寫在一張張的信紙上六十多年後，台灣的樣貌早已完全改變，各個角落的人為生活而努力，幾個活在不同角落的小人物各自懷抱音樂夢想：失意樂團主唱阿嘉只會彈月琴的老郵差茂伯在修車行當黑手的水蛙唱詩班鋼琴伴奏大大小米酒製造商馬拉桑以及交通警察勞馬父子，這幾個不相干的人，竟然要為了度假中心演唱會而組成樂團，並在三天后表演，這點讓日本來的活動公關友子大為不爽，對這份工作失望透頂，每天頂著臭臉的友子也讓待過樂團的阿嘉更加不高興，整個樂團還沒開始

programme.title: 金派特務
programme.desc: 根據線報，大量走私槍枝即將流入韓國，菜鳥特務流茶熙（李善彬 飾）被指派前往韓國進行機密調查，為確保任務順利，進而尋求國情局的優秀臥底協助，卻陰錯陽差遇上笨手笨腳又貪財的私家偵探禹手罕（金英光 飾）兩人聯手調查，不僅零默契且漏洞百出，還讓相關人證都莫名被消失，甚至被當成頭號嫌疑犯！究竟這兩個超母湯特務，能不能保全性命，並順利完成任務呢？

programme.title: 犯罪都市2
programme.desc: 掃蕩加里峰洞任務後過了4年，衿川刑警隊前往越南引渡逃走的嫌犯怪物刑警馬錫道和全日萬組長發現在當地的嫌犯十分可疑，得知其背後有個凶惡殘暴的主使者姜海相馬錫道和衿川刑警隊奔走於韓國和越南兩地，開始緝捕史上最壞的傢伙姜海相

programme.title: 邊緣行者
programme.desc: 1997年香港回歸前夕，多方勢力矛盾激化，暴力事件頻傳巨變當前，黑幫龍頭林耀昌（任達華 飾）對親信阿駱（任賢齊 飾）委以幫派重任多重身份的阿駱在黑白邊緣行走，一場除暴行動正悄然掀開反殺的序幕

programme.title: 厄憶追凶
programme.desc: 講述80多歲患有阿爾茨海默症的老人弼株尋找在朝鮮日治時期殺害所有家人的親日派並進行計畫了60多年的復仇，和無意捲入他復仇中的20多歲至親仁奎的故事

programme.title: 拼命三郎
programme.desc: 不再風光的江湖老大石三郎，替多年沒見的兒子石頭解決紛爭，兒子重新認識父親，並受到啓發而專注泰拳，兩代拼命逆流打拼，三郎的事業重上軌道之際，卻因與昔日兄弟恩怨而讓兒子受害，兒子泰拳前途被徹底摧毁，三郎為了兒子的明天，作出最拼命的反擊！

programme.title: 極速快遞
programme.desc: 銀河是名特別的駕駛，只要能拿到報酬，不論什麼東西都能配送成功某天在她讓孩子書元上車後，竟捲入了出乎意料的事件中

programme.title: 送院途中
programme.desc: 救護隊員馬志業堅持救人至上，時常不按章法規定行事，為了搶救病患做到五勞七傷；跟著上司石Sir調職過來的王維視晉升為工作的最大目標，兩人理念背道而馳，在合作時互相產生許多矛盾這時，屯門公路發生了嚴重事故，王維發現石Sir不顧傷患，一心只想搶到主導指揮權，決定跟隨後來趕到現場的馬志業指揮，二人同心拯救傷者

programme.title: 航海王電影版-紅髮歌姬
programme.desc: 在一座小島上，世界上最受歡迎的神秘女歌手美音即將首次公開表演，美音擁有被讚賞為異次元的優美聲音，會場上坐滿了來自世界各地的粉絲，包括海賊及海軍全世界期待已久的歌聲即將迴盪！故事將從她是紅髮傑克的女兒？這令人震驚的事實展開

programme.title: 灌籃高手第1集
programme.desc: 日本漫畫家井上雄彥以高中籃球為題材的漫畫和動畫作品，故事敘述一名國中時期便創下50次失戀紀錄的著名壞學生 櫻木花道，直到進入湘北高中，因為對同校女同學 赤木晴子產生好感，受到她的鼓勵後，櫻木決定加入籃球隊，從此展開了他的籃球生涯...而湘北高中籃球隊，有著第一中鋒赤木以及明星球員流川楓，另外剛出院的後衛宮城和神射手三井也陸續歸隊，再加上自稱為天才籃球手的櫻木花道的加入，這五個人將合力一起進軍神奈川區籃球代表隊的對抗賽，並打入四強，之後更和四強中的海南陵南翔陽3校爭奪全國大賽的代表權過程不僅精采刺激，內容更是扣人心弦，充分表現出高中籃球選手不屈不撓且努力奮鬥的精神！同時球隊隊友之間
